## Income Tax Filing Pakistan | FBR Certified
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/income-tax-filing
Summary: Expert income tax filing service. Same-day filing from Rs 3,500. FBR certified. Salaried, freelance, business, rental income. Lahore tax consultant.

Q: When should I file my return?
A: File between July 1 and September 30 each year. Filing after deadline incurs penalties. It's best to file by September 15 to avoid rush.

Q: What if my employer already deducted tax?
A: You must still file your personal return. You'll likely get a refund if tax was over-deducted. You remain on Active Taxpayer List only after personal filing.

Q: Can I file for multiple years at once?
A: Yes. Back returns can be filed, though penalties apply for late filing. Contact us for multi-year filing packages.

Q: What documents do I need?
A: Salary slips, NIC, investment receipts (NSCs, SBs), rental income proofs, bank statements showing major transactions.

## Income Tax Return Pakistan 2026 — Complete FBR Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/income-tax-return-pakistan
Summary: Learn how to file income tax return in Pakistan 2026. FBR IRIS steps, slabs, documents, deadline & who must file. Expert help: 0328-4675162.

Q: Who is required to file income tax return in Pakistan?
A: Anyone earning taxable income, owning assets above the threshold, running a business, or doing freelance work may be required to file an income tax return. It is highly recommended even for those below the threshold to enjoy filer benefits.

Q: How can I file income tax return online in Pakistan?
A: You can file online through the official FBR IRIS Portal at iris.fbr.gov.pk. You will need your CNIC-registered phone number for OTP verification and your NTN to login.

Q: What is the filing deadline for income tax return 2026?
A: The income tax return for FY 2024–25 is due by 30 June 2026 for individuals and AOPs. Filing before the deadline ensures your ATL status is maintained for the following year.

Q: What happens if I do not file my tax return?
A: Non-filers face higher withholding taxes on banking, property, and vehicle transactions, along with potential FBR notices and penalties of PKR 1,000 per month for late filing.

Q: What is the cost of income tax filing in Lahore?
A: The cost depends on the complexity of your income and business structure. Kamboh Associates offers transparent, affordable packages for individuals, freelancers, and businesses. Contact us for a free consultation.

## NTN Registration Pakistan 2026 — Online FBR Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/ntn-registration
Summary: Get NTN registration in Pakistan 2026. Step-by-step IRIS guide for individuals & businesses. Documents, fees, same-day service. Call 0328-4675162.

Q: What is NTN and who needs it in Pakistan?
A: NTN (National Tax Number) is a unique identifier issued by FBR to every taxpayer. Every Pakistani earning income above the taxable threshold, running a business, owning property, or holding significant bank deposits legally needs an NTN. Salaried individuals, freelancers, business owners, companies, and AOPs all require NTN registration under the Income Tax Ordinance 2001.

Q: What documents are required for NTN registration?
A: For individuals: CNIC copy, recent utility bill (electricity or gas), mobile number registered on CNIC, email address. For business/AOP: CNIC of all owners/partners, partnership deed, utility bill of business premises, bank account number. For companies: SECP registration certificate + director CNICs.

Q: How long does NTN registration take?
A: With Kamboh Associates, you receive a temporary NTN on the same working day. The permanent printed NTN certificate from FBR takes 7–10 working days. The entire process is 100% online — no FBR office visit required.

Q: Can a student or housewife get NTN?
A: Yes. Any Pakistani citizen aged 18+ with a valid CNIC can register for NTN — including students, housewives, and retired persons. Having NTN does not mean you owe tax. Many people get NTN specifically to become ATL filers and save on withholding taxes.

Q: What happens if I don't register for NTN?
A: Without NTN, you are classified as a non-filer and face higher withholding tax rates on banking transactions, property purchases, and vehicle registration. FBR can also issue notices under Section 114 requiring you to file returns if your income or assets indicate taxable activity.

Q: Is NTN registration free? What is the actual cost?
A: FBR itself charges no government fee for NTN registration. Kamboh Associates charges Rs. 2,000 for individual NTN and Rs. 2,500 for business/AOP NTN as a professional service fee for handling the IRIS portal registration, document preparation, and certificate follow-up.

## Corporate Tax Return Filing Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/corporate-tax-return
Summary: Annual corporate tax return for private limited companies and AOPs. Tax computation, WHT reconciliation, SECP filing. From Rs. 18,000. WhatsApp 0328-4675162.

Q: What is the corporate tax rate in Pakistan 2026?
A: Standard corporate tax rate is 29% of taxable income. Small companies with turnover under Rs. 250M may qualify for reduced rates. Minimum tax under Section 113 is 1.25% of gross turnover where regular tax is lower.

Q: When is the corporate tax return deadline?
A: For companies with fiscal year ending June 30, the deadline is December 31. For December year-end, deadline is June 30. Late filing penalty is Rs. 40,000 or 0.1% of tax payable — whichever is higher.

Q: Does my Pvt Ltd company need an audit?
A: Companies with paid-up capital over Rs. 1 million or annual turnover exceeding Rs. 25 million must get accounts audited by a chartered accountant. We can coordinate audit through our CA network.

Q: What is minimum tax Section 113 for companies?
A: Section 113 imposes a minimum tax of 1.25% on a company's gross turnover where the regular tax liability is lower . This ensures all active companies pay some minimum level of tax. Even companies with heavy expenses or losses must pay minimum tax on their revenue if they have turnover above the threshold.

Q: Can companies carry forward losses?
A: Yes. Tax losses (where allowable deductions exceed taxable income) can be carried forward for 6 years to offset future profits, reducing tax liability in profitable years. Proper documentation and return filing are required to preserve this benefit. Losses must be claimed in the return for the year they occurred.

Q: Does a newly registered company need to file a return?
A: Yes. A newly incorporated private limited company must file an income tax return from the first tax year it is registered, even if it had no revenue or operations. A nil return with the incorporation date and zero income must still be filed to avoid non-filing penalties.

Q: What is advance tax for companies and when must it be paid?
A: Companies must pay advance tax in quarterly instalments (typically in July, October, January, April) based on estimated annual tax liability or previous year's tax. Under-payment of advance tax attracts default surcharge. Kamboh Associates calculates and manages quarterly advance tax payments as part of our corporate compliance package.

## STRN Sales Tax Registration Pakistan
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/sales-tax-registration
Summary: Expert STRN (Sales Tax Registration Number) service. Get registered for GST/sales tax in 3 days. Monthly filing included. Starting from PKR 3,000.

Q: What is the difference between STRN and NTN?
A: NTN (National Tax Number) is your income tax registration number — required for filing income tax returns. STRN (Sales Tax Registration Number) is a separate registration for sales tax / GST purposes. You need NTN first, then you can apply for STRN. Both are issued through FBR IRIS portal.

Q: Is government registration fee charged for STRN?
A: No — FBR does not charge a government fee for STRN registration. The only cost is the professional fee charged by a tax consultant to prepare and submit your application. Kamboh Associates charges Rs. 3,000 for the complete STRN registration service.

Q: What if I don't have any sales — do I still need to file monthly returns?
A: Yes. Once STRN registered, you must file a monthly sales tax return every month — even if you had zero sales that month. Missing a monthly return attracts a Rs. 10,000 penalty per return. Kamboh Associates can handle your monthly returns for Rs. 3,000/month regardless of sales volume.

Q: Should I get provincial sales tax (PRA/SRB) or federal STRN?
A: It depends on your service type and location. Services are taxed provincially: Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA) for Punjab, Sindh Revenue Board (SRB) for Sindh, KPRA for KPK, BRA for Balochistan. Goods are taxed federally by FBR. Some businesses need both. Contact Kamboh Associates to determine the correct registration for your business.

Q: Can I deduct GST I paid on purchases from GST I collect on sales?
A: Yes — this is the key benefit of STRN registration. Input tax adjustment allows you to offset the GST you paid on business purchases against the GST you charge on sales. You only deposit the net difference to FBR. This makes being STRN-registered financially beneficial for most businesses.

## Monthly Sales Tax Return Filing Service Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/sales-tax-return
Summary: Sales tax return filing in Pakistan by Kamboh Associates. FBR-certified — monthly STRM filing, sales tax registration & compliance. WhatsApp 0328-4675162.

Q: What is the monthly sales tax return deadline?
A: The monthly sales tax return must be filed by the 18th of the following month. For example, January return must be filed by February 18. Late filing attracts Rs. 10,000 fine plus 1.5% per month default surcharge on outstanding tax.

Q: What if I have no sales this month?
A: You must still file a Nil return by the 18th. Failure to file even a nil return attracts the same Rs. 10,000 penalty. We include nil return filing in every monthly package at no extra charge.

Q: Can I claim input tax on all purchases?
A: Input tax can only be claimed on purchases from STRN-registered suppliers with valid FBR invoices. Section 8B restricts input to 60% of output tax for some categories. We ensure maximum legitimate input is claimed.

Q: What is the difference between federal sales tax and provincial sales tax?
A: Federal sales tax (GST) at 18% applies to goods and is administered by FBR. Provincial sales tax on services is administered by provincial bodies — Punjab Revenue Management Authority (PRMA) at 16%, Sindh Revenue Board (SRB) at 13%, KPK Revenue Authority (KPKRA) at 15%, and Balochistan Revenue Authority (BRA) at 15%. If your business provides services, you may need to register with the relevant provincial authority in addition to or instead of FBR.

Q: How is sales tax return filed on FBR IRIS?
A: Log in to iris.fbr.gov.pk using your STRN credentials. Navigate to Sales Tax > Returns. Upload Annex-A (purchase data) and Annex-C (supply data). The system automatically calculates net tax payable. Generate a PSID (Payment Slip ID) and pay through any bank branch or mobile banking. Submit the return before the 18th. Kamboh Associates handles this entire process — you only need to share your monthly invoice data.

Q: Can a business with no GST registration issue tax invoices?
A: No. Only STRN-registered businesses can issue sales tax invoices. Buyers cannot claim input tax on purchases from unregistered suppliers. This is one of the key reasons businesses voluntarily register even below the Rs. 10 million threshold — their corporate buyers often require STRN-registered invoices to claim their own input tax.

Q: What documents are needed for sales tax return filing?
A: You need: all sales invoices (output supplies) for the month, all purchase invoices from STRN-registered suppliers (for input tax claims), bank statements for verification, and any debit/credit notes issued or received. For FBR POS-integrated businesses, the POS system generates most of this data automatically. Kamboh Associates requests a simple Excel or WhatsApp-shared summary and handles all the IRIS portal work.

## FBR Notice Defense Service Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/fbr-notice-defense
Summary: Expert FBR notice response. Section 111, 114, 122, 177 audit defense. 24-hour legal response on FBR IRIS. WhatsApp 0328-4675162 for free review.

Q: How do I respond to a Section 111 FBR notice?
A: Respond within 30 days by submitting a written reply via IRIS (FBR portal) under the Correspondence section. Your reply must explain the source of each unexplained amount with documentary evidence (bank statements, inheritance documents, remittance records). Kamboh Associates drafts Section 111 replies within 24 hours. Call 0328-4675162 immediately.

Q: Can I appeal an FBR notice if I disagree with the assessment?
A: Yes. If FBR issues an assessment order you believe is wrong, you can appeal to the Commissioner (Appeals) within 30 days, then to the Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue (ATIR) within 60 days of the appellate order, and finally to the High Court on questions of law. Kamboh Associates represents clients at all appeal levels.

## Wealth Statement Filing Service Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/wealth-statement
Summary: Wealth statement filing Pakistan — Kamboh Associates. FBR-compliant reconciliation for salaried, business & property owners. Call 0328-4675162.

Q: Is wealth statement mandatory?
A: Yes. Under Section 116 of Income Tax Ordinance 2001, every person required to file an income tax return must also submit a Wealth Statement showing all assets and liabilities as of June 30.

Q: What if my assets increased but income is low?
A: This is the most common cause of Section 111 (unexplained income) notices. We carefully reconcile asset additions with all income sources — gifts, inheritance, loans — to prepare a clean, defensible wealth statement.

Q: Do I need to declare gold and jewelry?
A: Yes. Gold, jewelry, and household items are declared at their current market value. We help you calculate fair values per FBR guidelines so you stay compliant without overpaying.

Q: What happens if I forget to declare a property or asset?
A: FBR cross-references your wealth statement with property registry data, bank records, and vehicle records. Undeclared property discovered during an audit is treated as unexplained wealth under Section 111, taxed at full rate plus 100% penalty. If you have missed assets in previous years, we can help you file an amended return to bring your records into compliance before FBR discovers it independently.

Q: Do overseas Pakistanis need to file a wealth statement?
A: Overseas Pakistanis who are non-resident for tax purposes are not required to declare foreign assets in the Pakistani wealth statement. However, any assets held in Pakistan — property, bank accounts, businesses — must be declared. If you have a Roshan Digital Account, funds held in it are also declarable. Resident Pakistanis must declare all global assets.

Q: Can wealth statement be amended after filing?
A: Yes. FBR allows amendment of wealth statement within 5 years of the original filing. If you discover a missed asset or an error after filing, the amended return can be submitted on IRIS. We recommend filing an amendment proactively rather than waiting for FBR to raise a notice — voluntary disclosure is treated more favourably than audit-triggered discovery.

Q: What documents do I need to share for wealth statement filing?
A: You need: CNIC, previous year's wealth statement (if applicable), bank statements for all accounts as of June 30, property documents (purchase deeds, FBR property valuations), vehicle registration certificates, investment statements (mutual funds, shares, prize bonds), gold weight and purchase date, outstanding loan statements, and a note of any cash kept at home. Kamboh Associates sends a simple checklist — most clients share documents via WhatsApp in under 30 minutes.

## Withholding Tax Compliance Service Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/withholding-tax
Summary: Withholding tax compliance in Pakistan: WHT statements, deductions and FBR portal filing by Kamboh Associates. Call 0328-4675162 for same-day help.

Q: What is the penalty for not filing monthly WHT statement?
A: Under Section 182 of ITO 2001, failure to file WHT statement attracts Rs. 2,500 per day of default, plus 25% surcharge on late tax. This can accumulate to lakhs quickly.

Q: Who must deduct withholding tax?
A: All registered companies, AOPs registered for income or sales tax, government departments, and e-enrolled withholding agents must deduct and file WHT statements.

Q: What is the WHT rate on contractor payments?
A: Section 153 rates: 7% for filers on services, 14% for non-filers. For supply of goods: 4.5% filers, 9% non-filers. Rates vary by payment type and ATL status of payee.

Q: What WHT sections apply to salaried employees?
A: Employers must deduct income tax from salaries under Section 149 at the applicable slab rate based on the employee's annual salary. The deduction must be made at the time of payment and deposited with FBR within 7 days. A monthly salary statement must be maintained. Failure to deduct makes the employer personally liable for the tax due.

Q: What is the monthly WHT filing deadline?
A: Monthly withholding tax statements must be filed by the 15th of the following month via FBR IRIS. Tax deducted must be deposited within 7 days of deduction. Late payment attracts a default surcharge of 12% per annum on the outstanding amount.

Q: Are filer and non-filer WHT rates different?
A: Yes. Non-filers pay up to double the WHT rate of active filers on most payment categories. For example, WHT on services is 7% for filers vs 14% for non-filers. This rate differential is one of the strongest incentives for businesses to maintain active filer status. Kamboh Associates can register your NTN and get you on the ATL within 48 hours.

## EOBI Registration Service Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/eobi-registration
Summary: EOBI registration & monthly contribution filing Pakistan. Employer registration, employee enrollment & compliance by Kamboh Associates. Call 0328-4675162.

Q: Is EOBI registration mandatory?
A: Yes. Under the EOBI Act 1976, every employer with 5 or more workers must register with EOBI within 30 days of reaching 5 employees. Non-compliance attracts prosecution and arrears with 10% annual surcharge.

Q: What is the EOBI contribution amount?
A: Employer contributes 5% of minimum wage (Rs. 37,000 from July 2025) = Rs. 1,850 per employee per month. Employee contributes 1% = Rs. 370 per month. Total Rs. 2,220 per employee deposited with EOBI monthly.

Q: What benefits do employees get from EOBI?
A: EOBI provides old-age pension, invalidity pension, survivors' pension, and old-age grant. Employees become entitled after 15 years of contribution and reaching 60 years of age (55 for women).

Q: What is the penalty for not registering with EOBI?
A: Under the Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act 1976, failure to register an establishment carries a fine of up to Rs. 50,000 and/or 6 months imprisonment for the employer. Non-payment of monthly contributions attracts additional penalty surcharge. Labour inspectors can conduct surprise visits and issue show-cause notices to unregistered employers.

Q: Who is an "insured person" under EOBI?
A: Any employee in an EOBI-covered establishment earning wages up to Rs. 50,000 per month is an insured person. Employees earning above this threshold are still required to contribute but their contribution is capped. Casual workers, contract workers, and part-time employees in covered establishments may also be required to register depending on the nature of their employment.

Q: Can I register EOBI online in Pakistan?
A: Yes. EOBI registration is done online through the EOBI portal (eobi.gov.pk). Employers must submit a Form E-1 (Employer Registration Form) along with CNIC, NTN, business registration certificate, and a list of employees. After approval, EOBI issues an Employer Registration Number and assigns unique employee EOBI numbers. Kamboh Associates handles the complete online registration process — WhatsApp 0328-4675162.

## AOP Tax Return Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/aop-tax-return
Summary: AOP and partnership tax return filing in Pakistan: firm return on IRIS, partners' share, withholding duties and fees from Rs 8,000 with Kamboh Associates.

Q: What is an AOP for tax purposes in Pakistan?
A: An Association of Persons (AOP) includes partnerships, joint ventures, and any combination of persons who carry on business jointly. Under Pakistan tax law, an AOP is treated as a separate taxable entity and must file its own return in addition to each partner filing individually.

Q: When is the AOP tax return deadline?
A: AOP tax returns are due by September 30 each year for the preceding tax year (July-June). Late filing attracts penalties under Section 182 of Income Tax Ordinance 2001.

Q: Do partners also need to file individual returns?
A: Yes. Each partner must declare their share of AOP profit in their individual income tax return. We handle both the AOP return and partner individual returns in our Medium and Large packages.

Q: What tax rate applies to an AOP?
A: AOPs are taxed at the same progressive rates as individuals (0% to 35%) under the Income Tax Ordinance 2001. However, the AOP pays tax on its total income first, then distributes net profit to partners.

## Freelancer Tax Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/freelancer-tax-pakistan
Summary: Freelancer tax filing service Pakistan — NTN registration, FBR return, Upwork/Fiverr income declaration, and filer status. Kamboh Associates. WhatsApp 0328-4675162.

Q: I earn from Fiverr. Do I need to file a tax return?
A: Yes. If you earn from any foreign platform and receive payment in Pakistan (bank or Payoneer/Wise), you must file a tax return. Even if your total income is below the taxable threshold, filing a nil or low-tax return maintains your active filer status which saves money on many daily transactions.

Q: What if I never filed before — can I start now?
A: Yes. You can file for Tax Year 2026 (July 2025 – June 2026) and also retroactively for up to 5 previous years. Many freelancers regularize their tax position in one session. Kamboh Associates handles this process completely — WhatsApp us with your bank statements and we take care of the rest.

Q: Do I need to pay GST / Sales Tax on my freelance services?
A: No. IT services exported to foreign clients are zero-rated for Sales Tax under SRO 1012. This means no GST is charged on your invoices to foreign clients. You may register for STRN voluntarily for documentation purposes but you do not need to collect GST from your foreign clients.

Q: I earn from local clients in PKR as well. How does that affect my tax?
A: Local PKR income is taxed under normal business slabs (starting at 15% above Rs. 600,000). You declare foreign and local income separately in your IRIS return. The 1% concessional rate only applies to foreign remittances — local income follows standard rates.

Q: What is the tax rate on foreign remittances for freelancers?
A: Foreign remittances received through banking channels (Payoneer, Wise, bank transfer) are taxable as business income at standard slab rates. However, export of IT services and software (including freelance services) is subject to reduced tax rates: 0.25% for IT exports under a special exemption (verify against current Finance Act — rates change annually). Remittances received via hundi or informal channels are not entitled to any exemptions and are treated as unexplained income.

Q: Do I need a separate bank account for freelance income?
A: FBR does not require a separate bank account, but it is strongly recommended. A dedicated account for freelance income makes it much easier to reconcile your income statement with bank records during filing. It also helps if FBR ever audits your wealth statement — you can show a clean trail of income vs expenditure. Most platforms (Payoneer, Wise) allow you to link a dedicated account.

## SECP Pvt Ltd vs Sole Proprietorship Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/secp-vs-sole-proprietorship-pakistan
Summary: SECP Private Limited vs sole proprietorship Pakistan 2026. Corporate tax 29% vs 35% slab, limited liability, compliance costs compared.

Q: Sole Proprietorship ka tax rate company se zyada hota hai?
A: Not always. Sole Proprietor personal slabs par tax deta hai (0–35%), company 29% corporate tax. Lower income levels par sole prop ka rate company se kam hota hai. Higher income par company ka flat 29% sometimes better hota hai — especially with tax planning strategies.

Q: Sole Proprietorship se company mein convert hona possible hai?
A: Haan. Sole Proprietorship ko baad mein Pvt Ltd mein convert kiya ja sakta hai — SECP mein fresh incorporation, assets/liabilities transfer, FBR NTN update. Yeh process possible hai aur commonly done hota hai. Consultant ki help se properly karein.

Q: SECP company ka annual compliance kitna kharcha aata hai?
A: SECP annual filing fees (Form A, Form 29), accounts preparation, tax return filing, aur agar audit required ho — sab mila kar Rs. 30,000 se Rs. 1,00,000+ tak aa sakta hai depending on company size aur complexity.

Q: Freelancer ke liye sole proprietorship better hai ya company?
A: Mostly sole proprietorship. Freelancers ke liye Individual NTN sufficient hota hai — NTN hi aapka tax ID hai. Company ke additional compliance costs (SECP, audit, annual filings) usually justify nahi hote unless you have significant reasons (investors, foreign company requirement, team of 10+).

Q: Foreign company requirement ke liye SECP registration zaroori hai?
A: Haan. Kuch international clients (especially US/UK companies) require karte hain ke Pakistani vendor properly incorporated company ho. In cases mein Pvt Ltd company banana investment worth it hai — credibility aur contract execution dono ke liye.

Q: SECP company register karne mein kitna time lagta hai?
A: SECP portal par online application se 5–10 working days normally. Documents complete hon, company name available ho, aur application correct ho — to process smooth rehta hai. Kamboh Associates SECP registration fast track mein handle karta hai.

## Startup Registration Pakistan 2026 — SECP & FBR Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/startup-registration-pakistan
Summary: How to register a startup in Pakistan 2026. SECP Pvt Ltd, NTN, PSEB, bank account setup — complete step-by-step guide. Call 0328-4675162.

Q: Can I register a startup online in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Both FBR NTN registration (via iris.fbr.gov.pk) and SECP company registration (via secp.gov.pk) can be done completely online. Kamboh Associates handles online registrations for clients across all cities in Pakistan — submit documents via WhatsApp.

Q: How long does startup registration take in Pakistan?
A: Sole Proprietor NTN: 1–2 days. Partnership Firm: 3–5 days. SECP Private Limited Company: 7–15 working days. With a consultant handling the process, timelines are faster because errors that cause rejections are avoided.

Q: Do I need SECP registration for a small business in Pakistan?
A: No. Small businesses, shops, freelancers, and solo professionals do not need SECP registration. An FBR NTN is sufficient to legally operate as a Sole Proprietor. SECP registration is only required if you want to form a Private Limited Company or One Person Company.

Q: What is the minimum capital requirement for SECP company registration?
A: There is no minimum paid-up capital requirement for registering a Private Limited Company with SECP in Pakistan. However, your authorized capital determines the government registration fee. Companies with PKR 100,000 authorized capital pay lower fees.

Q: Is GST (STRN) registration required for all new businesses?
A: No. Sales Tax STRN registration is only required if your business supplies taxable goods or services and your annual turnover exceeds PKR 10 million. Freelancers and small service businesses generally do not need STRN unless they have large corporate clients requiring tax invoices.

## Income Tax Calculator Pakistan 2025-26 — FBR Slabs
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/tax-calculator
Summary: Free Pakistan income tax calculator 2025-26. Calculate your exact FBR income tax based on official slabs. Salaried, freelancer, business. By Kamboh Associates.

Q: Is this calculator accurate for FBR?
A: This calculator uses the official FBR tax slabs from the Finance Act 2026. It provides a close estimate of your tax liability, but actual tax may differ based on specific deductions, credits, and FBR assessment. For exact figures, consult Kamboh Associates.

Q: What if my income comes from multiple sources?
A: If you have income from salary, business, property, and investments, each source may be taxed at different rates. FBR's IRIS system handles multi-source income declarations. Kamboh Associates can prepare your complete return covering all income sources at 0328-4675162.

Q: What is the income tax exemption limit in Pakistan 2026?
A: For tax year 2027, the income tax exemption threshold is Rs.600,000 per year for salaried individuals. Income up to this amount is taxed at 0%. Above Rs.600,000, progressive tax rates apply starting from 2.5% up to 35% for income above Rs.6 million.

Q: How is salary tax calculated in Pakistan?
A: Salary tax in Pakistan is calculated by multiplying your monthly salary by 12 to get annual income, then applying the applicable slab rate from the FBR tax table. The employer deducts this tax monthly under Section 149 and deposits it with FBR. You can use Kamboh Associates salary tax calculator above for an instant estimate.

Q: Can I reduce my salary tax in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Salaried employees can reduce income tax through: pension fund contributions (Section 63 — up to 20% of salary deductible), equity mutual fund investments (Section 62 — tax credit up to Rs.150,000), health and life insurance premiums, and charitable donations to approved NGOs. Inform your HR department about these investments to reduce monthly deductions.

Q: Do I still need to file a return if tax is already deducted from my salary?
A: Yes. Even if your employer deducts tax at source under Section 149, you must still file an annual income tax return by September 30. Filing your return is what puts you on the Active Taxpayer List (ATL) and gives you filer status. Without filing, you remain a non-filer and pay higher withholding taxes on property, banking, and vehicle transactions regardless of how much salary tax was already deducted.

Q: How do I get tax refund in Pakistan if too much tax was deducted?
A: If excess tax was deducted from your salary or business income, you can claim a refund by filing your income tax return and showing the overpayment. FBR processes refunds within 45-60 days of return filing. You need your CPR numbers (tax payment receipts) and employer certificate (Form 16) to support the refund claim. Kamboh Associates handles refund claims at 0328-4675162.

## GST & Sales Tax Calculator Pakistan 2026 — Add/Remove Tax Instantly
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/gst-calculator
Summary: Free Pakistan GST & sales tax calculator 2026. Add tax to any price or remove GST from total. Supports 18% federal and 16%, 15%, 13% provincial rates.

Q: What is the process to hire Kamboh Associates for tax filing?
A: Simply WhatsApp 0328-4675162 with your name, CNIC, and what service you need. We confirm the fee upfront, you send your documents digitally, and we file the same day. For company registrations and complex matters, we send you a detailed checklist of required documents.

Q: Does Kamboh Associates serve clients outside Lahore?
A: Yes. All our services are available nationwide and for overseas Pakistanis. We serve clients in Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, Quetta, and internationally in UAE, UK, USA, Canada, and Saudi Arabia. Everything is done online via WhatsApp — no office visit required.

Q: What is the standard GST rate in Pakistan 2026?
A: The standard GST (General Sales Tax) rate in Pakistan for 2026 is 18% on locally manufactured goods and 25% on imported luxury goods. Certain items like basic food products, medicines, agricultural inputs, and exports are zero-rated or exempt from GST. The rate was increased from 17% to 18% in the Finance Act 2023 and has remained 18% since then.

Q: Who needs to register for sales tax (STRN) in Pakistan?
A: Any business with annual taxable supplies above Rs.10 million must register for sales tax with FBR and obtain a Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN). Retailers above a certain turnover threshold, manufacturers regardless of turnover, and importers must also register. Voluntary registration is also permitted and often recommended as it allows claiming input tax credits.

Q: How is input GST different from output GST?
A: Output GST is the sales tax you charge your customers on your sales. Input GST is the sales tax you paid to your suppliers on your purchases. The net GST payable to FBR = Output GST minus Input GST. If your input GST exceeds output GST, you have a refundable balance (excess input tax) which FBR can either refund or carry forward to next month.

Q: When is the GST return due date in Pakistan?
A: The monthly sales tax return must be filed and payment deposited by the 18th of each month for the previous month's transactions. For example, June transactions must be reported by July 18. Late filing attracts a penalty of Rs.10,000 per return. Kamboh Associates handles monthly GST filing for businesses starting from Rs.5,000 per month.

Q: What items are exempt from GST in Pakistan?
A: GST exempt items in Pakistan include: basic foodstuffs (wheat, rice, flour, pulses, vegetables, fruits), medicines and pharmaceutical products, agricultural seeds and fertilizers, educational books and materials, and financial services. Exported goods are zero-rated (0% GST) rather than exempt, which is better because exporters can still claim input tax refunds on zero-rated exports.

Q: Kya salaried person ko filer hona zaroori hai?

## ATL Pakistan 2026 — How to Get on FBR Active Taxpayer List
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/atl-pakistan-guide
Summary: FBR Active Taxpayer List (ATL) Pakistan 2026. Check via SMS 9966, pay ATL surcharge (Rs. 25,000 individual), get lower WHT rates.

Q: Kya sirf NTN lene se ATL mein naam aa jata hai?
A: Nahi. NTN registration aur ATL mein naam ana do alag cheezein hain. ATL mein naam aane ke liye aapko har saal income tax return file karni zaroor hai . Sirf NTN lene se aap registered to hain lekin non-filer hain.

Q: ATL mein naam kab aata hai return file karne ke baad?
A: Return file karne ke 24 se 72 ghante ke andar generally naam aa jata hai. ATL har Monday ko update hoti hai. Agar return file ki hai to agle Monday tak confirm ho jata hai. SMS 9966 par CNIC send karke check karein.

Q: ATL surcharge kab lagti hai?
A: ATL surcharge un logon par lagti hai jo September 30 ki deadline ke baad return file karte hain. Surcharge pay karne ki last date 1 March hoti hai. Individual ke liye Rs.25,000, AOP ke liye Rs.50,000, company ke liye Rs.100,000. Surcharge pay karne ke baad naam wapas ATL mein aa jata hai.

Q: Kya ATL check free hai?
A: Haan, bilkul free hai. Aap kisi ka bhi ATL status check kar sakte hain — SMS 9966 par CNIC send karein ya atl.fbr.gov.pk par check karein. Koi charge nahi.

Q: Agar main saal mein ek baar return file karta hoon to kya saal bhar active filer rehta hoon?
A: Haan. Ek baar return file karne ke baad aap agle saal ki return ki deadline (September 30) tak active filer rehte hain. Is liye agle saal bhi time par return file karna zaroori hai — warna inactive ho jaoge.

Q: Nil income hai — kya phir bhi ATL mein naam aa sakta hai?
A: Haan. Agar aapki koi taxable income nahi hai to aap "nil return" file kar sakte hain — zero income ki return. ATL mein naam aa jayega aur aapko sab filer benefits milenge. Kamboh Associates se nil return filing ke liye rabta karein.

## How to Check ATL Status Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/how-to-check-atl-status-pakistan
Summary: Check FBR ATL status instantly in Pakistan 2026: SMS ATL [CNIC] to 9966, visit atl.fbr.gov.pk, or login to IRIS. Updated every Monday. Not on ATL?

Q: ATL check karna free hai?
A: Haan, bilkul free hai. SMS method mein standard SMS charges lag sakte hain lekin atl.fbr.gov.pk par check karna completely free hai — koi registration ya login nahi chahiye.

Q: Kya main kisi doosre ki CNIC ka ATL check kar sakta hoon?
A: Haan, ATL publicly accessible hai. Aap kisi bhi CNIC ka status check kar sakte hain — chaahe aap seller hain, buyer hain, ya business partner. Yeh information confidential nahi hai — FBR ne ise deliberately public rakha hai.

Q: Return file karne ke baad ATL update kitne din mein hoti hai?
A: Generally 24-72 ghante. Lekin FBR ATL har Monday ko officially update karti hai. Agar aap ne shaam ko return file ki to agle ek-do din mein SMS 9966 se check karein — Active aana chahiye.

Q: IRIS portal par login ka password bhool gaya — kya karo?
A: IRIS portal par "Forgot Password" option hai. CNIC aur registered mobile number se OTP verify karke password reset kar sakte hain. Agar yeh bhi nahi ho to FBR helpline 0800-00227 par call karein ya Kamboh Associates se madad lein.

Q: ATL check mein "Not in ATL" aaya — kya aur koi raasta hai?
A: "Not in ATL" result ka matlab hai aap non-filer hain. Wapas active hone ke liye income tax return file karni hogi ya late filing ATL surcharge pay karni hogi. Kamboh Associates yeh process aapke liye handle karta hai — WhatsApp karein 0328-4675162.

## NTN Registration Online Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/ntn-registration-online-pakistan
Summary: How to get NTN registration online in Pakistan 2026. IRIS portal, documents required, same-day NTN for individuals, freelancers, and businesses.

Q: Is NTN the same as CNIC?
A: For individuals, FBR uses your CNIC number as NTN in many systems. However, formal IRIS registration links your CNIC to a tax profile, giving you login access and enabling e-filing. Without IRIS registration, you cannot file returns online or access your tax records.

Q: How long does NTN registration take?
A: Individual NTN registration on IRIS is typically completed within 24 hours, often immediately. Business NTN (AOP, Company) may take 2–3 days as FBR verifies business documents. Kamboh Associates handles same-day completion for individual NTN.

Q: I already have NTN but forgot my IRIS password — what do I do?
A: Use the "Forgot Password" link on IRIS. Enter your CNIC and registered mobile — an OTP is sent. If you no longer have access to the registered mobile, you must visit the nearest FBR Regional Tax Office (RTO) with your CNIC to reset access.

Q: Can a freelancer working from home get NTN?
A: Yes. Freelancers register as individuals on IRIS. Home address is acceptable. After NTN, you file your annual return declaring foreign income from Fiverr, Upwork, Wise, Payoneer etc. FBR provides a reduced 0.25% tax rate on freelancer foreign earnings (IT services).

## Income Tax Slab Pakistan 2026 — Updated FBR Tax Rates
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/income-tax-slab-pakistan-2026
Summary: Complete income tax slab table for Pakistan 2026. Salaried individuals, business owners, AOP, and corporate tax rates. Calculate your exact FBR tax liability.

Q: Are the tax year 2025 slabs used for returns due in September 2026?
A: No. Returns due in September–October 2026 are for tax year 2026, which uses the revised slabs from the Finance Act 2025.

Q: How do freelancers find the right slab?
A: Freelancers usually have business income and use the non-salaried slabs, unless their IT export income is taxed under the reduced regime on proceeds.

Q: Are income tax slabs the same as last year?
A: FBR revises slabs every year in the Federal Budget (June). For Tax Year 2026, the salaried slabs shown above are the current applicable rates under the Finance Act 2025-26. Always verify on iris.fbr.gov.pk or with a registered tax consultant before filing.

Q: If I have both salary and business income, which slabs apply?
A: Salary income is taxed under salaried slabs and business income is taxed under business slabs — they are not combined. You declare both separately in your IRIS return. IRIS auto-calculates the correct tax for each type of income.

Q: What is the minimum income to file a tax return in Pakistan?
A: Legally, if your income is below Rs. 600,000 (the zero-tax threshold), you are not required to file. However, filing even a nil return is strongly recommended — it makes you an active filer and saves 50% on WHT rates on property, banking, and vehicles.

## Budget 2026-27 New Salary Tax Slabs Pakistan — Complete Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/budget-2026-27-salary-tax-slabs-pakistan
Summary: Pakistan Budget 2026-27 new salary tax slabs explained. 4 slabs reduced, 9% surcharge abolished. See exactly how much tax you pay now. Updated July 2026.

Q: What is the minimum salary exempt from tax in Pakistan 2026-27?
A: Annual income up to Rs 600,000 (Rs 50,000 per month) is completely exempt from income tax for salaried individuals. This threshold was not changed in Budget 2026-27.

Q: Will my employer automatically apply the new tax slabs?
A: Legally yes — employers are required under Section 149 to apply current tax rates from July 2026. However, check your July payslip to confirm the updated deduction. If over-deducted, claim a refund in your annual return.

Q: I earn Rs 300,000/month. How much less tax will I pay?
A: At Rs 300,000/month (Rs 3,600,000 annually), your income falls in two changed slabs. Your estimated annual saving is approximately Rs 35,000–45,000. For a precise figure, WhatsApp Kamboh Associates at 0328-4675162 for a free calculation.

Q: What is the surcharge that was abolished?
A: It was a 9% additional tax levied on the income tax payable by salaried individuals earning more than Rs 10 million annually. Budget 2026-27 abolished this surcharge completely, effective Tax Year 2027.

Q: Do freelancers get the same new tax slabs?
A: Freelancers and IT exporters registered with PSEB continue under the 0.25% Final Tax Regime on foreign remittance income, which was extended to June 2029 in Budget 2026-27. The new salary slabs do not apply to freelancer income — that falls under non-salaried rates.

## Salary Tax Calculator Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/salary-tax-calculator-pakistan-2026
Summary: Salary tax calculator Pakistan 2026-27. FBR income tax slabs for salaried employees — Rs 6 lakh tax-free, Rs 12 lakh 5%, Rs 22 lakh 15%.

Q: Pakistan mein kitni salary par income tax nahi lagta 2026?
A: Budget 2026-27 mein salaried employees ke liye Rs 6,00,000 (6 lakh) annual income tax-free hai. Yani Rs 50,000 per month salary tak zero tax. Rs 6 lakh se zyada par progressive slab rates lagti hain — 5% se shuru ho kar 35% tak.

Q: Rs 1 lakh salary par kitna tax lagta hai Pakistan 2026?
A: Rs 1 lakh per month (Rs 12 lakh annual) salary par FBR 2026-27 slab ke mutabiq: pehle Rs 6 lakh zero, baaki Rs 6 lakh par 5% = Rs 30,000 annual tax. Monthly withholding: Rs 2,500 per month. Yani Rs 1 lakh salary mein se Rs 2,500 tax monthly kaat ta hai employer.

## Withholding Tax Pakistan 2026 - Complete Rates & Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/withholding-tax-pakistan-2026
Summary: Complete withholding tax guide Pakistan 2026. WHT rates for salary, bank, property, vehicles, contracts, imports for filers and non-filers. How to claim WHT refund.

Q: Can I get a refund if too much WHT was deducted?
A: Yes, if your total adjustable WHT paid exceeds your final income tax liability calculated in your annual return, the excess is refundable. File your return, and if a refund is due, apply to the Commissioner via IRIS. Refunds are typically processed within 3–6 months.

Q: What if my employer deducted wrong WHT from salary?
A: The employer's WHT deduction is reflected in your annual return. If it was too high, you receive a refund when you file. If too low, you must pay the shortfall. Always verify your employer's tax certificate (Form 16) against your actual salary before filing your return.

Q: Is WHT on bank profit the final tax or can I get it back?
A: Bank profit WHT under Section 151 is an adjustable advance tax for filers — you can credit it against your annual tax and claim a refund if excess. For non-filers, it becomes a final tax at 30% — no refund, no credit. This is why becoming a filer significantly reduces effective bank tax.

## Advance Tax Pakistan 2026 — Section 147 Quarterly Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/advance-tax-pakistan-2026
Summary: Advance tax Pakistan 2026 guide — Section 147 quarterly advance tax calculation, payment deadlines, who must pay, and penalties for non-payment.

Q: Does advance tax apply to first-year taxpayers with no prior assessed tax?
A: For first-year taxpayers with no prior year assessed tax, the advance tax instalment is based on the current year estimated tax. You estimate your income for TY2026 and compute the tax payable — 25% of this estimated tax is due each quarter. There is no requirement to pay advance tax in the first year if you genuinely cannot estimate income, but underpayment against final tax will attract default surcharge when the return is filed.

Q: I am a salaried employee — do I need to pay advance tax?
A: Pure salaried employees whose employer deducts monthly WHT under Section 149 are exempt from Section 147 advance tax. However, if you have non-salary income (rental income, freelance income, investment income) that is not covered by employer WHT, you must pay Section 147 advance tax on that additional income component. The advance tax is computed only on the non-salary income portion in this case.

Q: What happens if I miss an advance tax instalment?
A: Missing an advance tax instalment triggers the default surcharge under Section 205 at KIBOR + 3% per annum on the unpaid amount from the due date. You should pay the late instalment as soon as possible to minimize the surcharge accrual. The default surcharge is not a penalty — it is an interest charge that continues to run until the principal is paid. It is declared in your annual return and paid along with any remaining tax balance.

Q: Can I reduce my advance tax if my business had a bad year?
A: Yes. Section 147 allows you to file a revised estimate of your current year income and reduce future instalment amounts if your actual income is expected to be lower than the prior year assessed income. File the revised estimate in IRIS before the relevant instalment due date. However, if you revise down and actual income ends up higher than your estimate, you will owe default surcharge on the underestimated amount at year end.

Q: How do I verify my advance tax payment was correctly recorded in IRIS?
A: Log in to IRIS and navigate to Payments → Payment History. Your advance tax payments appear with date, amount, and PSID reference. If a payment does not appear within 5 business days of bank payment, contact your bank with the payment receipt — banks sometimes input incorrect NTN or tax year codes which prevents IRIS matching. FBR's helpline (051-111-772-772) can assist with payment tracing if needed.

Q: Is advance tax applicable to rental income?
A: Yes. Rental income is subject to Section 147 advance tax if your total tax liability (including rental income tax) exceeds Rs. 1 million. However, note that tenants who are WHT agents must deduct WHT at source on commercial rent payments under Section 155. This Section 155 WHT is adjustable against your Section 147 advance tax and final tax liability — ensure your tenants issue WHT certificates so you can claim the credit in your annual return.

## Wealth Statement Pakistan 2026 - How to File & What to Include
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/wealth-statement-guide-pakistan-2026
Summary: Wealth statement guide for Pakistan 2026: what to declare, how reconciliation works, cash, gold and liabilities, and the mistakes that trigger notices.

Q: Should I show a loan from a relative in my wealth statement?
A: Yes, as a liability, supported by a written acknowledgement and preferably a bank transfer record.

Q: Is a wealth statement required if my income is below the taxable limit?
A: Yes. If you own property, a vehicle, or have significant bank balances, you must file a wealth statement even if your income is below the taxable threshold. The wealth statement is filed as part of the income tax return.

Q: What if my wealth increased more than my declared income?
A: You must explain the source of the extra wealth — a documented loan, a gift with proper gift deed, inheritance, or previously declared savings. Unexplained wealth increase is treated as income under Section 111 and taxed accordingly plus penalties.

Q: Do I need to declare gold and jewelry in my wealth statement?
A: Yes. Gold and jewelry must be declared with approximate weight and current market value. There is no exemption threshold — all jewelry must be included. Undisclosed gold is a common trigger for FBR notices in high-value cases.

Q: Can a tax consultant help me file my wealth statement?
A: Yes. Kamboh Associates specializes in wealth statement filing and reconciliation. We review your assets, liabilities, and income to ensure your wealth statement is consistent and reduces the risk of FBR notices. WhatsApp 0328-4675162 for a consultation.

## Late Filing Penalty Income Tax Pakistan 2026 — Rates & How to Avoid
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/late-filing-penalty-income-tax-pakistan
Summary: Late income tax return penalty in Pakistan 2026: how section 182 penalty orders arrive, default surcharge vs ATL surcharge, and evidence that reduces it.

Q: Is the late filing penalty charged automatically by IRIS?
A: No. It is normally imposed through a notice and an order after the return is filed late, and you can reply before the order is made.

Q: What is the difference between a penalty and default surcharge?
A: The penalty is for the late return; default surcharge under section 205 is charged on tax paid late, for the period of delay.

Q: What is the penalty for late income tax filing in Pakistan?
A: The penalty for late filing of an income tax return in Pakistan is typically a percentage of the tax payable, with a minimum fixed penalty amount, increasing the longer the delay continues, in addition to potential exclusion from the Active Taxpayers List.

Q: What happens if I miss the income tax return deadline?
A: If you miss the September 30 deadline, you can still file a late return, but you will face a penalty, lose ATL filer status until the surcharge is paid and ATL inclusion is processed, and face higher withholding tax rates as a non-filer in the interim.

Q: Can the late filing penalty be reduced or waived?
A: In certain cases, taxpayers can apply for penalty waiver or reduction by demonstrating reasonable cause for the delay, though approval is at FBR's discretion and is not guaranteed, making timely filing the safer option.

## Tax Refund Pakistan 2026 — How to Claim Your FBR Income Tax Refund
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/tax-refund-pakistan-2026
Summary: How to claim your FBR income tax refund in Pakistan 2026: IRIS refund process, the 60-day legal deadline, FASTER sales tax refunds, and delay/rejection fixes.

Q: Is there a deadline for claiming an income tax refund?
A: Yes. Refunds must be claimed within the period set in the law, so old unclaimed excess deductions can be lost.

Q: How long does FBR take to process a tax refund?
A: By law, FBR is required to process a refund application within 60 days of filing. In practice, simple refunds (especially for salaried persons) can be processed faster, while refunds involving sales tax or larger amounts may take longer and require follow-up.

Q: Can I claim a refund for previous tax years?
A: Yes, refund claims can generally be made within 3 years of the relevant tax year, but you must have filed the corresponding income tax return for that year first. Filing late returns to claim old refunds is possible but requires proper documentation.

Q: Why is my refund delayed or not received?
A: Common reasons include incomplete bank account details on IRIS, mismatched WHT certificates not reflecting in your withholding statement, pending verification by the tax officer, or the refund application not being separately filed after the return (in some cases a separate refund application is required).

Q: How fast can exporters get a sales tax refund in Pakistan?
A: Through the FASTER system, claims that pass automated risk checks with no red flags can be processed within as little as 72 hours. Claims flagged for supplier non-filing or valuation mismatches are routed to manual review, which takes considerably longer.

Q: Can I carry forward a refund instead of taking cash?
A: Yes. Instead of a cash refund, you can elect to carry the excess forward as an adjustment against next year's tax liability. This often processes faster since it skips the bank-disbursement verification steps, but switching back to a cash claim later requires a fresh application.

## FBR Notice After Tax Return Pakistan 2026 — What to Do

Q: How do I respond to a Section 111 FBR notice?
A: Respond within 30 days by submitting a written reply via IRIS (FBR portal) under the Correspondence section. Your reply must explain the source of each unexplained amount with documentary evidence (bank statements, inheritance documents, remittance records). Kamboh Associates drafts Section 111 replies within 24 hours. Call 0328-4675162 immediately.

Q: Can I appeal an FBR notice if I disagree with the assessment?
A: Yes. If FBR issues an assessment order you believe is wrong, you can appeal to the Commissioner (Appeals) within 30 days, then to the Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue (ATIR) within 60 days of the appellate order, and finally to the High Court on questions of law. Kamboh Associates represents clients at all appeal levels.

## How to Avoid FBR Notice in Pakistan 2026 - Prevention Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/how-to-avoid-fbr-notice-pakistan
Summary: Complete guide to avoiding FBR notices in Pakistan 2026. 10 ways to prevent FBR tax notices, correct wealth statement filing.

Q: What happens if I ignore an FBR notice?
A: FBR can pass an order based only on the information it holds, which is harder to undo through appeal than replying on time.

Q: What triggers most FBR notices in Pakistan?
A: Property purchases are the single biggest trigger - especially when the buyer is a non-filer or when declared income does not support the property value. Other major triggers include undeclared bank profit, vehicle registrations by non-filers, and discrepancies between bank deposits and declared business income.

Q: If I file every year, will I never get an FBR notice?
A: Filing reduces but does not eliminate notice risk. Returns with incorrect or incomplete information can still trigger amendment notices (Section 122) or audit (Section 177). This is why professional filing is important - correct, complete returns are the best defence against FBR scrutiny.

Q: I bought a car as a non-filer last year. Will I get a notice?
A: Possibly. FBR tracks all vehicle registrations against CNIC. If you have significant assets (vehicles, property) but are not a filer, you are at risk of a Section 114 notice. The solution is to file your return now, declare the vehicle in your wealth statement, and explain the source of funds. Kamboh Associates handles this proactively.

Q: Can a professional tax consultant actually reduce my notice risk?
A: Yes, meaningfully. Most notices stem from data mismatches between your return and what FBR already knows from banks, property registrars, and employers — a professional reviews these sources before filing rather than after a notice arrives, which is exactly the reconciliation most self-filed returns skip. It doesn't guarantee zero notices, but it removes the majority of preventable triggers.

Q: Does having multiple bank accounts increase my notice risk?
A: Not by itself — but every account must be declared in your wealth statement, and profit from each account must be declared as income. The risk comes from forgetting an account exists, not from having several. Keep a simple list of all accounts (even dormant ones) and cross-check it against your wealth statement every year.

## Bank Profit Tax Pakistan 2026 — Section 151
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/bank-profit-tax-pakistan-2026
Summary: Bank profit par tax Pakistan 2026. Section 151: filer 15% vs non-filer 35%. Rs 5 lakh profit par non-filer Rs 1 lakh extra tax deta hai.

Q: Bank savings account par kitna tax lagta hai Pakistan 2026?
A: Bank savings account ki profit par Section 151 WHT lagta hai: filer ke liye 15% aur non-filer ke liye 35%. Bank khud tax kaat ke FBR ko jama karta hai. Rs 1 lakh profit par: filer Rs 15,000 tax, non-filer Rs 35,000 tax — Rs 20,000 ka farq sirf filer status se.

## Rental Income Tax Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/rental-income-tax-guide-pakistan-2026
Summary: Rental income tax Pakistan 2026 guide. Rs 25,000/month tak zero tax. Rs 1 lakh/month par Rs 62,500 annual tax.

Q: Pakistan mein kiraye ki amdani par kitna tax lagta hai 2026?
A: Section 15 ke under rental income slabs: Rs 3 lakh annual tak zero. Rs 3–6 lakh par 5%. Rs 6–24 lakh par Rs 15,000 + 10%. Rs 24 lakh+ par Rs 1,95,000 + 25%. Rs 1 lakh/month (Rs 12 lakh annual) rental income par: Rs 15,000 + 10% of Rs 6 lakh = Rs 75,000 annual tax.

## Tax on Property Sale Pakistan 2026 — CGT Rates & FBR Rules
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/tax-on-property-sale-pakistan-2026
Summary: Tax on property sale in Pakistan 2026: 236C advance tax at 2.75% or 5.5%, capital gains rules by acquisition date, worked example and declaring the sale.

Q: Does a longer holding period always reduce CGT?
A: Only for property acquired before 1 July 2024. Property acquired after that date is generally taxed at a flat rate regardless of holding period.

Q: Is there CGT on a property I inherited?
A: Inheritance itself is not taxed. But when you sell inherited property, CGT applies on gains from the FBR valuation at time of inheritance to the sale price.

Q: What is the difference between CGT and withholding tax on property?
A: WHT (Section 236C) is collected upfront at transfer time as advance tax. CGT is the actual tax on your profit. WHT paid is credited against final CGT when you file your annual return — often resulting in a refund.

Q: Do I need to show property sale in my wealth statement?
A: Yes. Property you buy must appear in your wealth statement as an asset. When you sell it, the asset is removed and the sale proceeds should reflect in your income or be explained as a source of cash.

Q: Can I add construction or renovation cost to reduce my capital gain?
A: Yes. Genuine construction and major renovation costs, along with the original registration/legal costs, are added to your cost basis and reduce the taxable gain — but only with proper invoices and payment records. Routine repairs and maintenance do not qualify. Undocumented cash-paid construction cannot be claimed.

Q: What if I sell a property at a loss?
A: A capital loss on property can only be set off against capital gains from other property in the same or future tax years — it cannot reduce your salary, business, or other income. Keep clear records of any loss-making sale so it can be claimed against a future property gain.

## Property Transfer Tax 2026-27 Pakistan — 236C & 236K New Rates Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/property-transfer-tax-2026-27-pakistan-236c-236k
Summary: Budget 2026-27 halved property transfer WHT. Buyer (236K) from 2.5% to 1.25%. Seller (236C) from 5.5% to 2.75%.

Q: I am buying property in August 2026. What 236K rate do I pay?
A: August 2026 falls under Tax Year 2027 (July 2026 – June 2027). The new rate of 1.25% (filer) or 2.5% (non-filer) applies. If you are an active filer, you pay 1.25% of the higher of FBR value or deed value.

Q: Can I get a refund of 236K or 236C tax?
A: Yes, if you are an active filer. When you file your annual income tax return, 236K and 236C deductions appear as advance tax credit. If your total tax liability for the year is less than the amount deducted, you can claim the difference as a refund. Non-filers generally cannot adjust or refund this tax. File your return — Kamboh Associates handles returns from Rs 3,500.

Q: Does 236C apply if I am selling my own house where I live?
A: Yes. Section 236C applies to all immovable property sales regardless of whether it is your residence or investment property. The WHT is deducted at registration. However, whether this creates a final or advance tax liability depends on your individual income tax situation — consult a tax professional.

Q: Do 236C and 236K apply on agricultural land?
A: Generally, 236C and 236K apply to "immovable property" as defined in FBR's Schedule of valuation rates. Agricultural land in non-urban areas is typically outside FBR's urban valuation table and may not be subject to these sections. However, peri-urban or categorized agricultural land can be captured. Confirm the FBR valuation status of the specific land before your transaction.

Q: I sold property in June 2026. Am I subject to old or new rates?
A: If the registration deed was executed and registered before June 30, 2026 (end of Tax Year 2026), the old rates apply: 5.5% for sellers under 236C (if filer). If registration happened from July 1, 2026 onwards, the new rate of 2.75% applies.

Q: What is Capital Gains Tax on property — is it affected?
A: Capital Gains Tax (CGT) on the profit from property sale was not directly changed in Budget 2026-27 in the same way as 236C/236K. CGT rates depend on holding period (how long you owned the property) and filer status. 236C WHT is separate from CGT — 236C is an advance tax on the gross sale value, while CGT is on the net profit (sale price minus purchase price and costs). Both are adjustable in your income tax return if you are a filer.

## DHA Bahria Town Lahore Property Tax 2026 — 236C 236K Complete Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/dha-bahria-town-property-tax-lahore-2026
Summary: DHA Lahore aur Bahria Town property khareed ya bech rahe hain? 236C seller (2.75% filer) aur 236K buyer (1.25% filer) ka complete guide.

## Sales Tax Return Filing Pakistan 2026 — Complete FBR IRIS Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/sales-tax-return-filing-pakistan-2026
Summary: Sales tax return filing in Pakistan 2026: STRN registration, monthly IRIS filing by the 18th, input/output tax, penalties, and refunds explained.

Q: What is the standard sales tax rate on goods in 2026?
A: 18%, with reduced rates and exemptions for specific goods under the Sales Tax Act schedules, and zero-rating for exports.

Q: When is the deadline for monthly sales tax return in Pakistan?
A: The monthly sales tax return must be filed and payment made by the 18th of the following month. For example, June's return is due by July 18.

Q: What is the difference between input tax and output tax?
A: Output tax is the sales tax you charge and collect from your customers on sales. Input tax is the sales tax you pay to your suppliers on purchases. Net tax payable = Output Tax - Input Tax. If input exceeds output, you may claim a refund.

Q: Can I claim a refund if my input tax exceeds output tax?
A: Yes. If you have excess input tax (common for exporters), you can claim a refund from FBR — see our complete tax refund guide. The refund process requires proper documentation of all input tax invoices and may take several weeks to months.

Q: Do I need to file a sales tax return if I had no sales in a month?
A: Yes. A Nil return must still be filed by the 18th even with zero sales — non-filing (even of a Nil return) counts as a missed filing and can trigger the same penalties and STRN suspension as a normal late return.

Q: Can I cancel or de-register my STRN?
A: Yes, through an application on IRIS for de-registration, but only after all outstanding returns are filed, all liabilities are cleared, and FBR completes a review of your last 3 years of filings. De-registration typically takes several weeks to process.

## Sole Proprietor Tax Return Pakistan 2026 - Complete Filing Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/sole-proprietor-tax-return-pakistan-2026
Summary: How a sole proprietor files an income tax return in Pakistan 2026: profit computation, records under section 174, separate business account and fees.

Q: Do sole proprietors use the salaried tax slabs?
A: No. Individuals with business income use the non-salaried slab rates, which are different from the salaried slabs.

Q: How long should a sole proprietor keep business records?
A: At least six years after the end of the tax year, as required under section 174.

Q: What expenses can a sole proprietor deduct from business income?
A: Allowable deductions include: rent, salaries paid to employees (with WHT deducted), utilities, vehicle running expenses, depreciation on business assets, professional fees, and other genuinely incurred business expenses. Personal expenses are not deductible.

Q: Do I need to maintain accounts as a sole proprietor?
A: You must maintain basic business records: revenue records, expense receipts, and bank statements. FBR can ask to inspect records if a notice is issued. A simple Excel sheet is acceptable for small businesses; larger businesses may need formal accounts.

## Company Registration Cost in Pakistan — SECP Fees Explained
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/company-registration-cost-pakistan-secp
Summary: Complete company registration cost breakdown for Pakistan 2026: SECP government fee, consultant service fee.

Q: What is the total cost to register a Private Limited company in Pakistan?
A: Kamboh Associates' service fee starts at Rs. 15,000, plus SECP's own government fee which scales with your authorized capital and is confirmed once your capital structure is known.

Q: Is SECP's government fee included in the Rs. 15,000?
A: No — the Rs. 15,000 is the consultant service fee (MOA/AOA drafting, filing, NTN, bank account help). SECP's government fee is separate and depends on authorized capital.

Q: Is a sole proprietorship cheaper than a Pvt Ltd company?
A: Yes, significantly — sole proprietorship registration is Rs. 5,000 with no SECP involvement at all, versus Rs. 15,000+ plus SECP's fee for a Pvt Ltd company.

Q: Does company registration cost include the first year's tax filing?
A: No. Registration is a one-time cost; the corporate income tax return (from Rs. 18,000/year) and any monthly compliance are separate, ongoing services.

Q: Why do some SECP registration quotes vary so much between consultants?
A: Often because one consultant is quoting only their service fee while another is quoting service fee plus SECP's government charge — always ask which is included.

Q: How long does full Pvt Ltd company registration take?
A: 7 to 10 days from name reservation to Certificate of Incorporation in most cases, assuming no SECP objections requiring resubmission.

## Annual Company Filing Pakistan 2026 — SECP & FBR Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/annual-company-filing-guide-pakistan

Q: What is the income tax return deadline for Pakistan 2026?
A: The income tax return deadline for tax year 2026 (July 2025 to June 2026) is September 30, 2026 for individuals and salaried persons. Companies and AOPs have until December 31, 2026. Filing after these dates attracts a monthly penalty of Rs.1,000 (individuals) or Rs.10,000 (companies).

Q: How can I reduce my income tax in Pakistan legally?
A: Legal tax reduction options include: pension fund contributions deductible up to 20% of income (Section 63), equity mutual fund investment tax credit up to Rs.150,000 (Section 62), health and life insurance premium deduction (Section 62), donations to approved NPOs deductible up to 30% of income (Section 61), and claiming all legitimate business expenses. Consult Kamboh Associates at 0328-4675162 for personalized tax planning.

## Fiverr Income Tax Pakistan 2026 — Freelancer Tax Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/fiverr-income-tax-pakistan
Summary: Tax guide for Fiverr freelancers in Pakistan 2026. How to declare Fiverr income, NTN registration, 0.25% WHT, IT export exemption explained.

Q: Do Pakistani freelancers have to pay tax on Fiverr/Upwork income?
A: Yes. Income earned from Fiverr, Upwork, and other platforms by Pakistani residents is taxable in Pakistan. However, with IT export registration (PSEB), the tax rate can be as low as 0.25% of gross income received through banking channels. File your return and claim this reduced rate. Kamboh Associates handles freelancer tax filing starting at Rs.5,000.

Q: What expenses can a freelancer deduct from tax in Pakistan?
A: As a freelancer or self-employed professional in Pakistan, you can deduct: laptop and computer expenses, internet and mobile bills (business portion), software subscriptions, home office rent (proportionate), electricity bills (business portion), bank charges, and professional development courses. These deductions reduce your taxable income and thus your tax liability.

## Freelancer Wealth Statement Pakistan 2026 — FBR Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/freelancer-wealth-statement-guide
Summary: How freelancers file wealth statement in Pakistan 2026. Declare foreign income, Payoneer/Wise balance, assets & liabilities on FBR IRIS. Expert guide.

Q: Do I declare my Payoneer balance in the wealth statement?
A: Yes. Foreign wallet balances on 30 June are assets and are declared at the converted rupee value.

Q: Meri Payoneer mein $2,000 balance hai — kaise declare karun?
A: June 30 ko SBP exchange rate par $2,000 ko PKR mein convert karo (e.g. 278 = Rs. 5,56,000). Wealth statement mein "Foreign Currency Accounts/Balances" section mein declare karo. Next year June 30 par updated balance declare karo.

Q: Mera sara income IT export exempt hai — kya wealth statement filed karni chahiye?
A: Haan — income tax return aur wealth statement filing mandatory hai chahe income exempt ho. Exempt income return mein declare karo (exempt category mein), wealth statement mein apne sare assets declare karo. Non-filing pe penalty lag sakti hai.

Q: Meri maa ne mujhe ghar transfer kiya — kya declare karna hoga?
A: Haan — gift ya inheritance mein mila ghar bhi wealth statement mein declare karna hoga. Under "Immovable Assets" declare karo with source as "Gift from parent". Yeh wealth increase explain karega bina income ke.

Q: Previous years mein maine wealth statement declare nahi ki — ab kya karun?
A: Pehle ek tax consultant se milna chahiye. FBR ke paas 5 saal ka amendment window hota hai. Purani returns revise kar sakte hain. Agar undeclared assets significant hain to voluntary disclosure better hai FBR notice ka wait karne se.

## Software House Tax Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/software-house-tax-pakistan
Summary: Tax guide for software houses in Pakistan 2026. IT export income is 100% tax-exempt via PSEB. 0.25% WHT for filers.

Q: Do I need to register for sales tax if my business is online?
A: Yes, if your annual turnover from goods exceeds Rs.10 million. For online businesses selling services within Pakistan, provincial service tax may apply (PRA for Punjab, SRB for Sindh, KPRA for KPK). However, if your business earns exclusively from foreign clients (exports), you are generally exempt from Pakistani sales tax on those transactions.

Q: What is the minimum tax for a business in Pakistan?
A: Under Section 113 of the Income Tax Ordinance, businesses must pay a minimum tax of 1.25% of gross turnover even if they show a loss. For distributors and dealers, the minimum tax rate is 0.5%. This means even if your company makes no profit, you still owe FBR a minimum amount based on total sales. Proper tax planning can help manage this obligation.

## Export Services Tax Exemption Pakistan 2026 — IT Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/export-services-tax-exemption-pakistan
Summary: Tax exemption on export services in Pakistan 2026. Who qualifies, how to claim IT export WHT 0.25% benefit, PSEB registration & FBR process.

Q: Is SRO 1125 still valid in 2026?
A: Haan — SRO 1125(I)/2023 abhi bhi in effect hai. FBR ne isko cancel nahi kiya. Har saal ke Finance Act mein check karna chahiye ke koi changes to nahi hue. 2026 ke liye yeh SRO valid hai aur applicable hai.

Q: Do I need PSEB registration to claim IT export exemption?
A: PSEB (Pakistan Software Export Board) registration mandatory nahi hai SRO 1125 claim ke liye individuals ke liye. Companies ke liye bhi directly SRO 1125 apply hota hai bina PSEB ke. PSEB registration optional hai lekin kuch additional benefits de sakti hai.

Q: If I have both Pakistani and foreign clients, which income is exempt?
A: Sirf foreign client income IT export exempt hoti hai — Pakistani client income normal tax slabs par taxable hai. Dono ko alag records mein maintain karo. FBR return mein alag declare karo.

Q: Bank deducts 1% WHT on my foreign remittances — can I get it back?
A: Haan — yeh 1% WHT adjustable tax credit hai. Annual return mein total tax liability se minus hoga. Agar aapki saari income IT export exempt hai, to yeh 1% WHT fully refundable hai. Return submit karo aur refund claim karo IRIS mein.

Q: Can a Pvt Ltd company claim IT export exemption?
A: Haan — SECP registered Private Limited companies bhi SRO 1125 ke thet IT export exemption claim kar sakti hain. Company ke return mein IT export income ko exempt category mein declare karo. Same banking channel aur documentation requirements apply hoti hain.

## Tax on YouTube Income Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/youtube-monetization-tax-pakistan
Summary: Tax on YouTube income in Pakistan 2026. YouTubers pay 0.25% WHT on AdSense earnings, file FBR return by 30 September & declare in wealth statement.

Q: Kya YouTube AdSense income Pakistan mein taxable hai?
A: Haan. Pakistan mein resident ki sari income taxable hai including YouTube AdSense. Lekin W-8BEN form se US withholding avoid ki ja sakti hai, aur IT export exemption se Pakistan tax bhi significantly reduce ho sakta hai.

Q: W-8BEN form submit karna kyun zaroori hai?
A: W-8BEN form Google/YouTube ko batata hai ke aap non-US entity hain. Pakistan-US tax treaty ke under 0% US withholding rate applicable hai — form submit kiye bina 24% US tax deduct hota rehta hai. Yeh ek-bar kaam hai jo lazmi karna chahiye.

Q: YouTube income FBR mein kahan declare hoti hai?
A: IRIS mein "Business Income" ya "Income from Other Sources" section mein. Total AdSense + brand deal income PKR mein convert kar ke declare karein. Bank statement documentation ke tor par rakhein.

Q: Local brand deals (PKR mein) par kya tax lagta hai?
A: Company clients Section 153 ke under 3-6% WHT deduct karte hain. Yeh adjustable tax hai — return mein claim hota hai. Agar client individual hai (non-company), woh WHT deduct nahi karta — aap advance tax pay karte hain.

Q: Small YouTubers jo Rs. 6 lakh se kam kamate hain — unhe file karna chahiye?
A: Income tax slab ke liye Rs. 6 lakh tak 0% rate hai — lekin return file KARNA CHAHIYE. Return file karne se ATL mein naam aata hai, filer benefits milte hain, aur banking transactions par WHT 1% rehta hai (non-filer 2%).

Q: YouTube se zyada income hone par kya extra karna hoga?
A: Monthly Rs. 833,000+ ya saal mein Rs. 10 million+ income par sales tax registration lazmi ho sakti hai. Aur agar FBR notice aaye unexplained income ka — tab detail wealth statement tayyar rakhna zaroori hai. Consultant se regular consultation best practice hai.
