## AI Business Tax Pakistan 2026 — IT Company Tax Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/ai-business-tax-pakistan
Summary: Tax guide for AI businesses in Pakistan 2026. AI services export income, PSEB registration, 0.25% WHT, corporate tax & FBR compliance explained.

Q: Is AI consulting income taxable in Pakistan?
A: Haan, AI consulting income taxable hai. Lekin foreign clients se income, jab designated Pakistani bank ke zariye receive ki jaye, IT export exemption ke under significantly exempt ho sakti hai. Local Pakistani clients se income normal income tax slabs par taxable hoti hai.

Q: Do AI agencies qualify for IT export tax exemption?
A: Haan, AI agencies SRO 1125(I)/2023 ke under IT export exemption ke liye eligible hain kyunke AI services IT/software services ki category mein aati hain. Condition yeh hai ke payment foreign client se aaye aur designated Pakistani bank mein receive ho.

Q: Should I register as sole proprietor or company for an AI business?
A: Solo AI consultants ke liye Individual NTN kafi hai. Lekin agar aap employees hire karte hain, investors lana chahte hain, ya large contracts sign karte hain, toh Pvt Ltd company zyada suitable hai. Pvt Ltd mein limited liability, better credibility, aur easier bank account opening hoti hai.

Q: How is ChatGPT API reselling income taxed in Pakistan?
A: ChatGPT/OpenAI API reselling income ko FBR IT services income maanta hai. Agar aap Pakistani clients ko AI tools resell karte hain, yeh local business income hai. Agar foreign clients ko resell karte hain aur payment banking channel se aaye, IT export exemption apply ho sakti hai. OpenAI API charges aapki deductible business expense hain.

Q: What FBR forms does an AI business need to file?
A: Individual AI consultant: Annual Income Tax Return (ITR) on IRIS + Wealth Statement — deadline September 30. AI company (Pvt Ltd): Company Income Tax Return + Wealth Statement for directors + Monthly Withholding Statement (if paying salaries) + Annual Sales Tax Return (if registered). A tax consultant will ensure all forms are correctly filed.

## SaaS Company Tax Pakistan 2026 — Software Tax Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/saas-company-tax-pakistan
Summary: Tax guide for SaaS companies in Pakistan 2026. IT export WHT 0.25%, corporate tax, PSEB registration, subscription revenue FBR treatment explained.

Q: How is an annual SaaS subscription paid upfront treated?
A: On an accrual basis it is spread over the months of service; whatever method you use should be applied consistently each year.

Q: Is SaaS income taxable in Pakistan?
A: Haan, SaaS income taxable hai. Lekin international customers se income jo designated Pakistani bank ke zariye receive ho, IT export tax treatment ke under significantly exempt ho sakti hai. Local Pakistani customers se revenue normal business income tax rates par taxable hoti hai.

Q: Does Stripe or PayPal income from international SaaS customers qualify for IT export tax treatment?
A: Haan, agar Stripe ya PayPal income apne Pakistani bank account mein transfer ki jaye to IT export tax treatment claim ho sakti hai. Critical condition: paise designated Pakistani bank mein aane chahiye. Stripe/PayPal mein balance rakhna exemption ke liye sufficient nahi hai.

Q: When does a SaaS company need to register for sales tax?
A: Jab aapki annual local Pakistani customers se service revenue registration threshold se zyada ho jaye toh sales tax registration zaroori hai. Punjab mein PRA registration hoti hai. Export revenue is threshold mein count nahi hoti. Current threshold verify karne ke liye consultant se rabta karein.

Q: What is the income tax rate for local SaaS subscription revenue?
A: Local SaaS subscription revenue normal business income tax slabs par taxable hai. Salaried persons jaise slabs nahi hain — business income ke liye alag rates apply hoti hain. Expenses deduct karne ke baad net taxable income par tax lagta hai. Exact calculation ke liye consultant se milein.

Q: Can SaaS hosting costs (AWS, GCP) be deducted as business expense?
A: Haan, AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean — sab hosting costs legitimate business expenses hain aur taxable income se deduct ho sakti hain. Receipts aur invoices zaroor save karein. Ye expenses directly SaaS service delivery ke liye hain isliye 100% deductible hain.

## TikTok Creator Tax Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/tiktok-creator-tax-pakistan
Summary: Tax on TikTok creator income in Pakistan 2026. TikTok gifts & brand deals are taxable. File FBR return, get NTN, declare in wealth statement.

Q: Do Pakistani freelancers have to pay tax on Fiverr/Upwork income?
A: Yes. Income earned from Fiverr, Upwork, and other platforms by Pakistani residents is taxable in Pakistan. However, with IT export registration (PSEB), the tax rate can be as low as 0.25% of gross income received through banking channels. File your return and claim this reduced rate. Kamboh Associates handles freelancer tax filing starting at Rs.5,000.

Q: What expenses can a freelancer deduct from tax in Pakistan?
A: As a freelancer or self-employed professional in Pakistan, you can deduct: laptop and computer expenses, internet and mobile bills (business portion), software subscriptions, home office rent (proportionate), electricity bills (business portion), bank charges, and professional development courses. These deductions reduce your taxable income and thus your tax liability.

## Tax Filing for Doctors Pakistan 2026 — Complete FBR Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/tax-filing-doctors-pakistan
Summary: Income tax filing guide for doctors in Pakistan 2026. Private practice income, hospital WHT, clinic expenses, NTN registration & FBR return steps.

Q: Do doctors need to file income tax in Pakistan?
A: Yes. All doctors earning above Rs 600,000 annually must file an income tax return with FBR, regardless of whether they are salaried or in private practice. Non-filing leads to penalties and higher withholding tax rates on all transactions.

Q: What tax rate applies to a doctor's private practice income?
A: Private practice income is taxed under normal slab rates (0%–35%). Hospitals deduct 7.5% withholding tax on specialist fees, which is adjustable against total annual tax liability when you file your return.

Q: Can doctors deduct clinic expenses from taxable income?
A: Yes. Doctors running a private clinic can deduct rent, staff salaries, medical equipment depreciation, utilities, and professional fee expenses as business costs — directly reducing taxable income.

Q: When is the tax return deadline for doctors?
A: The annual income tax return for individuals (including doctors) is due by September 30 each year for the preceding tax year (July 1 – June 30).

Q: Do professionals need to register for sales tax in Pakistan?
A: Most professional services (medical, legal, engineering, architectural) are subject to provincial service tax, not federal sales tax. In Punjab, register with PRA; in Sindh with SRB; in KPK with KPRA. Registration is required if your annual service revenue exceeds the provincial threshold (typically Rs.4-10 million). Kamboh Associates handles all provincial service tax registrations.

Q: Can I run my professional practice as a company to save tax?
A: Yes. Running your practice as a Private Limited Company can offer tax advantages at higher income levels because the 29% corporate tax rate can be lower than the 35% top marginal individual rate. However, there are additional compliance costs (annual SECP filings, audit requirements). Kamboh Associates can analyze your specific situation and recommend the optimal structure.

## Income Tax Filing for Lawyers & Advocates Pakistan 2026
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/tax-filing-lawyers-pakistan
Summary: Income tax guide for lawyers and advocates Pakistan 2026. Bar Council WHT deducted at source, legal fee income, deductible expenses & FBR return steps.

Q: Do lawyers need to pay income tax in Pakistan?
A: Yes. All lawyers earning above Rs 600,000 per year must file an income tax return with FBR. Legal fees, retainers, and court awards are all taxable income. Non-filers pay double withholding tax on all transactions.

Q: What expenses can lawyers deduct from income tax?
A: Lawyers can deduct chamber rent, staff salaries, bar council fees, law library subscriptions, unreimbursed court filing fees, vehicle expenses proportionate to professional use, and professional development costs.

Q: Is there withholding tax on legal fees in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Corporate clients deduct withholding tax at source when paying legal fees. This withholding tax is adjustable against the lawyer's total annual tax liability — not a final tax. Claim it as a credit in your return.

Q: Do professionals need to register for sales tax in Pakistan?
A: Most professional services (medical, legal, engineering, architectural) are subject to provincial service tax, not federal sales tax. In Punjab, register with PRA; in Sindh with SRB; in KPK with KPRA. Registration is required if your annual service revenue exceeds the provincial threshold (typically Rs.4-10 million). Kamboh Associates handles all provincial service tax registrations.

Q: Can I run my professional practice as a company to save tax?

However, there are additional compliance costs (annual SECP filings, audit requirements). Kamboh Associates can analyze your specific situation and recommend the optimal structure.

## Tax Filing for Traders Pakistan 2026 — Business Tax Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/tax-filing-traders-pakistan
Summary: Income tax guide for traders and merchants in Pakistan 2026. Business income, turnover tax, advance tax, WHT on purchases & FBR return steps.

Q: Do engineers need to file income tax in Pakistan?
A: Yes. All engineers earning above Rs 600,000 annually must file with FBR. Salaried engineers use salary certificate; freelance engineers file under business income.

Q: What is the 0.25% tax for software engineers?
A: IT engineers receiving foreign currency via Pakistani banks can pay just 0.25% as final income tax on those remittances under SRO 1487(I)/2022 — instead of normal slab rates up to 35%.

Q: Can engineers deduct PEC membership fees?
A: Yes. PEC annual membership and renewal fees are deductible as professional expenses for engineers running a private practice or consultancy.

Q: Do I need to register for sales tax if my business is online?
A: Yes, if your annual turnover from goods exceeds Rs.10 million. For online businesses selling services within Pakistan, provincial service tax may apply (PRA for Punjab, SRB for Sindh, KPRA for KPK). However, if your business earns exclusively from foreign clients (exports), you are generally exempt from Pakistani sales tax on those transactions.

Q: What is the minimum tax for a business in Pakistan?
A: Under Section 113 of the Income Tax Ordinance, businesses must pay a minimum tax of 1.25% of gross turnover even if they show a loss. For distributors and dealers, the minimum tax rate is 0.5%. This means even if your company makes no profit, you still owe FBR a minimum amount based on total sales. Proper tax planning can help manage this obligation.

## Tax on Agricultural Income Pakistan 2026 — Provincial Guide
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/tax-on-agricultural-income-pakistan
Summary: Is agricultural income taxable in Pakistan 2026? Federal vs provincial treatment, Punjab agriculture tax slabs, exemptions & filing requirements.

Q: What is the income tax return deadline for Pakistan 2026?
A: The income tax return deadline for tax year 2026 (July 2025 to June 2026) is September 30, 2026 for individuals and salaried persons. Companies and AOPs have until December 31, 2026. Filing after these dates attracts a monthly penalty of Rs.1,000 (individuals) or Rs.10,000 (companies).

Q: How can I reduce my income tax in Pakistan legally?
A: Legal tax reduction options include: pension fund contributions deductible up to 20% of income (Section 63), equity mutual fund investment tax credit up to Rs.150,000 (Section 62), health and life insurance premium deduction (Section 62), donations to approved NPOs deductible up to 30% of income (Section 61), and claiming all legitimate business expenses. Consult Kamboh Associates at 0328-4675162 for personalized tax planning.

## Real Estate Developer Tax Guide Pakistan 2026 — Builders & Investors
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/blogs/real-estate-developer-tax-pakistan
Summary: Real estate tax guide Pakistan 2026: Section 7E, capital gains tax by holding period, 236C/236K advance tax, builder fixed tax scheme, and FBR valuation rules.

Q: What advance tax applies when a developer buys land?
A: For transfers from 1 July 2026, 1.25% under section 236K for buyers on the Active Taxpayers List and 2.5% for others.

Q: What is Section 7E tax on property in Pakistan?
A: Section 7E imposes tax on deemed income from immovable property, treating 5% of the FBR-determined fair market value of property as taxable income, taxed at 20%, effectively a 1% annual tax on property value, with certain exemptions for self-occupied property.

Q: Do real estate developers pay capital gains tax in Pakistan?
A: Yes, capital gains tax applies on profit from sale of property, with rates depending on the holding period — properties held longer than 6 years are generally exempt, while shorter holding periods attract tax on a sliding scale.

Q: What advance tax applies to property purchase and sale in Pakistan?
A: Section 236C applies advance tax on the seller and Section 236K on the purchaser, with non-filers paying significantly higher rates than active taxpayers, calculated on the FBR or DC valuation of the property.

Q: What is the fixed tax scheme for builders in Pakistan?
A: Under the Eighth Schedule, builders and developers can opt to pay a fixed tax based on covered/plotted area at FBR-notified per-square-foot or per-square-yard rates, instead of tax on actual declared profit. The rate is locked in once the project is registered and generally cannot be switched mid-project.

Q: How is a landowner-developer joint venture taxed in Pakistan?
A: If the landowner receives constructed units instead of cash, FBR can treat the handover as a taxable supply of the land at FBR-notified value. If the joint venture is structured as an AOP, the AOP files its own return in addition to each party declaring their share individually — get the structure reviewed before signing to avoid double taxation.

## Website Price in Pakistan 2026: What a Business Website Really Costs
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-price-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: In 2026 a template business website in Pakistan usually costs Rs 20,000 to Rs 80,000, a custom-designed business site Rs 80,000 to Rs 250,000, and an online store Rs 80,000 to Rs 600,000. On top of the build you pay roughly Rs 8,000 to Rs 25,000 a year for hosting and a domain. Our own prices start at Rs 40,500.
Key points:
- Most of the price difference comes from scope: number of pages, custom design versus a theme, and features such as payments or bookings.
- Budget for yearly costs as well as the build: a .pk domain is Rs 2,100 a year at the registry, and shared hosting is typically Rs 5,500 to Rs 15,000 a year.
- A cheap quote is not automatically a bad one, but ask exactly what it includes: content, revisions, mobile testing, SEO basics and who owns the domain.
- Pay in milestones, not 100% upfront, and get the scope and price in writing before any deposit.
- Our published prices: starter site Rs 40,500, business site Rs 85,500, online store Rs 157,500, web apps from Rs 360,000.

Q: How much does a simple website cost in Pakistan?
A: A simple three to five page website on a good theme usually costs Rs 20,000 to Rs 80,000 in 2026, depending on who writes the content and how much customisation you need. Our starter website is Rs 40,500 for up to five pages, mobile-first, with a contact form and basic SEO.

Q: Website kitne ki banti hai?
A: Ek aam business website Pakistan mein Rs 20,000 se Rs 250,000 tak mein banti hai, aur online store is se zyada mein. Hamari starter website Rs 40,500 aur business website Rs 85,500 ki hai, aur domain aur hosting ka saalana kharcha alag hota hai.

Q: Are domain and hosting included in the website price?
A: Usually not, and it is better that way. Domain and hosting should be registered in your own name and paid directly to the provider, so you are never locked in. Expect about Rs 8,000 to Rs 25,000 a year for both together on a typical business site.

Q: How much does an e-commerce website cost in Pakistan?
A: Published 2026 agency guides put online stores at roughly Rs 80,000 to Rs 600,000, depending on the number of products, payment methods and integrations. Our e-commerce package is Rs 157,500 for up to 100 products with cash on delivery, a payment gateway and courier booking.

Q: Why do website prices vary so much between developers?
A: Because the word website covers very different products. Page count, original design versus a theme, who writes the content, payments and other integrations, and the timeline all change the amount of skilled work involved. Compare quotes line by line, not by the headline number.

Q: Should I pay the full amount upfront?
A: No. A fair arrangement is a deposit to start, a payment at a mid-project checkpoint and the balance on delivery, with the scope and price agreed in writing first. Some agencies ask for 100% upfront on small packages, which leaves you with little leverage if the work stalls.

Q: How long does it take to build a website in Pakistan?
A: A template-based starter site can be ready in one to two weeks. A custom-designed business site usually takes two to eight weeks, and an online store three to fourteen weeks. Having your content and photos ready is the single biggest factor in keeping to the timeline.

Q: How much does website maintenance cost per month?
A: Vendor price guides put basic maintenance at around Rs 5,000 to Rs 15,000 a month, covering updates, backups and security. Larger stores need more. Our maintenance plans start at Rs 7,200 a month and are optional. Ask for the included tasks in writing before you sign.

Q: Can I get a website built in Pakistan if my business is abroad?
A: Yes. Many Pakistani teams, including ours, work with clients in the UK, the Gulf and North America. We quote and invoice in rupees, and clients pay by international bank transfer. Agree working hours, a written scope and milestones before starting.

Q: Does a website price include SEO?
A: Basic on-page SEO (page titles, descriptions, headings, image text and a sitemap) should be included in any professional build. Ongoing SEO work such as content and link building is a separate service. Ask each developer exactly which SEO basics are included.

## E-commerce Website Price in Pakistan: Shopify vs WooCommerce vs Custom
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/ecommerce-website-price-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: An ecommerce website in Pakistan typically costs Rs 80,000 to Rs 600,000 to build in 2026, depending on product count, payments and integrations. Running costs add hosting or a Shopify plan (from $29 a month billed yearly) and about 1.5–3% per wallet or card payment. Our store package is Rs 157,500.
Key points:
- The build price depends mainly on product count, payment and courier integrations, and how much custom design you want.
- The real cost of a store is build plus monthly running costs plus payment fees. Compare all three over two years, not just the build.
- Shopify Payments is not available to Pakistan-based businesses, so card and wallet payments on Shopify go through a third-party gateway and attract an extra Shopify fee on lower plans.
- Cash on delivery still dominates in Pakistan; a good store reduces fake COD orders with confirmation steps.
- Our e-commerce package: Rs 157,500 for up to 100 products, COD, a wallet or bank gateway, courier booking and order management.

Q: How much does an online store cost in Pakistan?
A: Building an online store in Pakistan usually costs Rs 80,000 to Rs 600,000 in 2026, depending on the number of products, payment and courier integrations and design. Our e-commerce package is Rs 157,500 for up to 100 products with COD, a payment gateway and courier booking.

Q: Online store banane ki qeemat kitni hai?
A: Pakistan mein online store aam tor par Rs 80,000 se Rs 600,000 tak mein banta hai. Hamara e-commerce package Rs 157,500 ka hai, jis mein 100 products tak, cash on delivery, JazzCash/Easypaisa ya bank gateway aur courier booking shamil hai.

Q: Is Shopify or WooCommerce cheaper for a Pakistani store?
A: WooCommerce usually has lower running costs because there is no monthly platform fee and no extra fee on gateway payments. Shopify costs more each month in US dollars but handles hosting and security for you. Compare both over two years, not just the build.

Q: Is Shopify Payments available in Pakistan?
A: No. Shopify Payments is not available to businesses based in Pakistan, so online payments on a Pakistani Shopify store go through a third-party gateway. On the Basic plan Shopify adds a 2% fee on those payments, on top of the gateway's own charge. Check Shopify's current terms before launch, because availability can change.

Q: What are payment gateway charges in Pakistan?
A: Reported 2026 figures are about 1.5–3% for JazzCash and Easypaisa wallets, about 2.2% for PayFast wallet and bank payments plus a setup charge, about 2.5–3% for local cards and about 3.5% for international cards. Rates are negotiated, so get written quotes.

Q: Do I need a payment gateway if I only take cash on delivery?
A: No, a store can launch with cash on delivery only. Adding a wallet or card option later usually increases sales and lets you offer a prepaid discount that reduces refused parcels. Plan the gateway even if you launch without it.

Q: How long does it take to build an e-commerce website?
A: A small theme-based store can launch in three to five weeks once products and photos are ready. Larger custom stores take two to three months. Product data entry and photography are usually the slowest parts, not the development. Supplying product photos and descriptions early is the easiest way to keep to schedule.

Q: Can I add products myself after the store is built?
A: Yes. Shopify and WooCommerce both let you add products, change prices and run discounts from an admin panel. Ask your developer for a short training session and a written guide as part of the handover. Ask for a short training session and a written guide at handover so your team can do it confidently.

Q: What monthly costs does an online store have?
A: Expect hosting or a Shopify plan, paid apps or plugins, payment gateway fees on each sale, courier charges and optional maintenance. For a small WooCommerce store the fixed part can stay under Rs 3,000 a month; Shopify starts at $29 a month billed yearly.

URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/shopify-store-price-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A Shopify store in Pakistan costs three things: the plan (Basic $29 a month billed yearly, Grow $79, Advanced $299), setup by a developer, and fees. Shopify Payments is unavailable in Pakistan, so gateway payments carry a 2% Shopify fee on Basic, while cash on delivery carries none.
Key points:
- Shopify bills Pakistani stores in US dollars; your rupee cost moves with the exchange rate and your bank's card charges.
- Yearly billing is about 25% cheaper than monthly billing on every standard plan.
- Because Shopify Payments is unavailable in Pakistan, online payments go through third-party gateways and attract a Shopify fee of 2%, 1% or 0.6% depending on the plan.
- Cash on delivery orders do not attract Shopify's transaction fee.
- Paid apps for reviews, courier booking or size charts are where Shopify budgets usually overrun.

Q: How much does Shopify cost per month in Pakistan?
A: Shopify's Basic plan costs $29 a month billed yearly or $39 billed monthly for Pakistani stores, according to a pricing check dated 9 October 2026. Grow is $79 or $105 and Advanced $299 or $399. Prices are in US dollars and can change, so confirm at checkout.

Q: Is Shopify Payments available in Pakistan?
A: No. Shopify Payments is not available to businesses based in Pakistan. Online payments go through a third-party gateway, and Shopify adds a transaction fee of 2% on Basic, 1% on Grow or 0.6% on Advanced on those payments. Check Shopify's current terms before launch, because availability can change.

Q: Does Shopify charge a fee on cash on delivery orders?
A: No. Cash on delivery is a manual payment method, so Shopify does not add its third-party transaction fee to those orders. You still pay the courier's delivery and COD collection charges, and you carry the cost of refused parcels, so confirm COD orders by WhatsApp before dispatch.

Q: How much does a Shopify developer charge in Pakistan?
A: Published 2026 guides put a professional Shopify store build at roughly Rs 80,000 to Rs 200,000, with custom builds higher and bare theme installs much lower. Our e-commerce package is Rs 157,500 and can be built on Shopify or WooCommerce.

Q: Shopify store banane ka kharcha kitna hai?
A: Shopify ke teen kharche hain: plan (Basic $29 mahana saalana billing par), developer se store banwana (aam tor par Rs 80,000 se Rs 200,000), aur fees (online payment par Basic plan mein 2% Shopify fee + gateway fee). COD par Shopify fee nahi lagti.

Q: Can I pay for Shopify from Pakistan?
A: Yes, usually with a debit or credit card enabled for international transactions. Shopify bills in US dollars, so your bank converts the amount and may add its own charges and taxes. Check your bank's terms before choosing yearly billing. Keep the billing card in your own name so the store stays under your control.

Q: Is Shopify or WooCommerce better for Pakistan?
A: Shopify is better if you want low maintenance and plan to sell internationally. WooCommerce is usually cheaper to run for stores relying on cash on delivery and local wallets, because there is no platform subscription or extra transaction fee. Compare the yearly running costs of both before deciding.

Q: Which Shopify plan should a new Pakistani store choose?
A: Most new stores should start on Basic, billed yearly at $29 a month. Upgrade to Grow only when the lower transaction fee on gateway payments (1% instead of 2%) saves more than the higher subscription, which usually needs substantial online-paid sales every month rather than mostly cash on delivery.

## WordPress Website Price in Pakistan: Theme, Custom and WooCommerce Costs
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/wordpress-website-price-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A WordPress business website in Pakistan usually costs Rs 25,000 to Rs 150,000 in 2026: about Rs 35,000 to Rs 80,000 for a theme-based site and more for custom design or WooCommerce stores. WordPress itself is free, but premium themes, paid plugins, hosting and updates are real costs. Our WordPress business sites start at Rs 40,500.
Key points:
- WordPress has no licence fee, which keeps build costs lower than many alternatives, but it needs regular updates.
- The biggest price driver is theme customisation versus custom design, followed by content and plugins.
- Never accept a site built on nulled (pirated) themes or plugins; they are a common source of malware.
- Running costs are hosting (about Rs 5,500 to Rs 15,000 a year for shared plans), a domain, plugin renewals and maintenance.
- Our prices: starter site Rs 40,500, business site Rs 85,500, WooCommerce store Rs 157,500.

Q: How much does a WordPress website cost in Pakistan?
A: In 2026 a WordPress business website in Pakistan typically costs Rs 25,000 to Rs 150,000, with simple theme-based sites around Rs 35,000 to Rs 80,000 and custom designs higher. Our WordPress starter site is Rs 40,500 and our business site Rs 85,500.

Q: Is WordPress really free?
A: The WordPress software is free, but a business website also needs a theme, often some paid plugins, hosting, a domain and someone to build and maintain it. These make up the real cost of a WordPress site. Budget for these yearly costs from the start, so renewals do not surprise you.

Q: WordPress website banwane ki qeemat kya hai?
A: Pakistan mein WordPress website aam tor par Rs 25,000 se Rs 150,000 tak mein banti hai. Hamari starter WordPress website Rs 40,500 aur business website Rs 85,500 ki hai. Hosting aur domain ka saalana kharcha alag hai. Domain aur hosting ka saalana kharcha alag hota hai.

Q: What is a nulled WordPress theme and why avoid it?
A: A nulled theme is a paid theme with its licence check removed and shared illegally. It can contain malicious code, never gets security updates and gives you no support. Always ask for licensed themes and plugins registered to your email.

Q: How much is WordPress hosting in Pakistan?
A: Shared hosting suitable for most WordPress business sites costs about Rs 5,500 to Rs 15,000 a year in Pakistan. Busy WooCommerce stores with many products or visitors may need VPS or cloud hosting, which typically costs Rs 25,000 or more a year. Always compare the renewal price, not only the first-year offer.

Q: Do WordPress websites need maintenance?
A: Yes. WordPress core, themes and plugins release frequent updates, many of them security fixes. Sites left without updates for months are the most common target for hacks and spam injections. Update monthly after taking a backup, or use a maintenance plan that tests updates before applying them to the live site.

Q: Can I edit my WordPress website myself?
A: Yes, and that is one of WordPress's main strengths. A good developer sets up editable blocks for text, images and offers, then gives you a short training session and a written guide, so you can update content, add blog posts and change prices without paying for every small edit.

Q: Is WordPress good for an online store in Pakistan?
A: Yes, through WooCommerce. It has no monthly platform fee or extra transaction fee, works with local payment and courier plugins, and suits stores that rely on cash on delivery. It does need regular updates and good hosting. Choose hosting with enough capacity for busy sale periods.

Key points:

- Pakistani agency rates in 2026 are roughly Rs 1,500 to Rs 8,000 an hour, depending on the size of the firm.
- A written scope with screens and user stories is the single best protection against cost overruns.
- Starting with a smaller first version (an MVP) and adding features later often halves the initial spend.
- Budget 15–25% of the build cost a year for hosting, fixes and small improvements.

Q: How much does a custom web application cost in Pakistan?
A: In 2026 a small single-purpose web app typically costs Rs 150,000 to Rs 400,000, a business system Rs 400,000 to Rs 1,000,000 and a complex platform Rs 1,000,000 or more. Our web apps start at Rs 360,000. A written scope is the only reliable way to get an accurate figure.

Q: How long does it take to build a web app?
A: A small tool can be built in four to eight weeks. A business system such as a booking platform or client portal usually takes two to four months, and complex platforms four to nine months, depending on scope and how quickly decisions are made.

Q: What are software developer rates in Pakistan?
A: One 2026 Pakistani guide lists indicative rates of about Rs 500 to 1,500 an hour for freelancers, Rs 1,500 to 3,500 for small agencies and Rs 3,000 to 8,000 for established software houses. Rates vary with experience and project size.

Q: How can I reduce the cost of a web application?
A: Build a first version with only the core user journey, reuse proven components instead of custom-building everything, limit integrations at launch, and write a detailed scope before development starts. Most overruns come from requirements discovered halfway through, so time spent on the scope is the cheapest saving available.

Q: Should I choose a fixed price or hourly billing for a web app?
A: A fixed price works well when the scope is written in detail. Hourly or monthly billing suits projects where requirements will change. Many projects combine both: a fixed-price first version, then hourly work for improvements. Either way, review working software every week or two so you can see real progress.

Q: Who owns the code of my web application?
A: You should. The agreement should state that the source code, database and accounts transfer to you on payment, and the code should live in a repository you control. Ask for this in writing before starting. Ask for the code repository to be created in your own account from the first day.

Q: Can a Pakistani team build a web app for my overseas business?
A: Yes. Many businesses in the UK, the Gulf and North America build web apps with Pakistani teams for cost and talent reasons. Agree overlapping working hours, a written scope with acceptance criteria, milestone payments and code ownership in your name before any development begins, exactly as you would with a local team.

Q: What maintenance does a web app need after launch?
A: A web app needs security updates, dependency upgrades, bug fixes, hosting management, backups and small improvements as users give feedback. A common rule of thumb is to budget 15 to 25 percent of the build cost each year, more if the app handles payments or sensitive customer data.

## Website Maintenance Charges in Pakistan: What a Monthly Plan Should Cover
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-maintenance-charges-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: Website maintenance charges in Pakistan are about Rs 5,000 to Rs 15,000 a month for most business sites in 2026, covering updates, backups, security checks and small edits. Online stores and frequently changed sites pay roughly Rs 15,000 to Rs 60,000. Our plans start at Rs 7,200 a month and are optional.
Key points:
- Maintenance is mainly about security updates, backups and uptime; content changes are the visible extra.
- Before you sign, check four things: what is included, how many hours of changes you get, how fast urgent problems are answered, and where backups are stored.
- Not every site needs a paid plan. A small site that rarely changes can be maintained by its owner with a simple monthly routine.
- WordPress and WooCommerce sites need more regular updates than Shopify stores, because Shopify handles the platform itself.
- Pay monthly or quarterly, and keep ownership of all accounts so you can switch provider at any time.

Q: How much does website maintenance cost per month in Pakistan?
A: Most business websites in Pakistan pay about Rs 5,000 to Rs 15,000 a month in 2026, while online stores and high-traffic sites pay roughly Rs 15,000 to Rs 60,000. Our plans start at Rs 7,200 a month and are optional.

Q: Website ki monthly fees kitni hoti hai?
A: Aam business website ki maintenance Pakistan mein takreeban Rs 5,000 se Rs 15,000 mahana hoti hai, aur online store ki is se zyada. Hamara plan Rs 7,200 mahana se shuru hota hai, aur zaroori nahi ke har website ko plan chahiye ho.

Q: What does website maintenance include?
A: A fair plan includes software and plugin updates, off-server backups, uptime and security monitoring, form and checkout tests, a set number of hours for small content changes, and a monthly report of the work done. Ask for exclusions in writing too, so there are no surprises later.

Q: Does every website need a maintenance plan?
A: No. A small site that rarely changes can be maintained by its owner with a monthly backup, update and testing routine. Stores, frequently updated sites and owners without time or technical confidence benefit most from a plan. Start with the free routine and upgrade only if it becomes a burden.

Q: Is hosting included in website maintenance?
A: Usually not, unless the plan says so. Hosting and domain fees are normally paid directly to the providers in your own name, which keeps you in control and makes it easy to change maintenance provider. Check the plan wording, and keep renewal invoices addressed to you.

Q: How often should a WordPress website be updated?
A: Check for updates at least once a month and apply security updates within days of release. Take a full backup first, update plugins one at a time, and test key pages, forms and checkout afterwards, because a plugin conflict can break a page or stop orders without any visible warning.

Q: Does a Shopify store need maintenance?
A: Less than a WordPress store, because Shopify maintains the platform, hosting and security. You still need to manage installed apps and their monthly costs, theme changes, product data, discount rules and regular checkout tests. Review apps every few months and remove any you no longer use.

Q: What happens if my maintenance provider disappears?
A: If the domain, hosting and admin accounts are in your name and backups are stored where you can reach them, another developer can take over quickly. This is why ownership of every account matters more than the monthly price. Keep a recent backup downloaded to your own computer as well.

## Domain and Hosting Price in Pakistan 2026: .pk vs .com and Which Hosting to Buy
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/domain-and-hosting-price-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: The domain and hosting price in Pakistan starts with a .pk domain at Rs 2,100 a year from the PKNIC registry since 1 August 2026, billed in two-year blocks, and shared hosting at about Rs 5,500 to Rs 15,000 a year. Register both in your own name, never your developer's.
Key points:
- PKNIC raised the .pk fee from Rs 1,800 to Rs 2,100 per domain per year on 1 August 2026; foreign registrants pay $15.99 a year.
- PKNIC bills on a two-year basis and allows prepayment for up to ten years.
- Shared hosting is enough for most business sites; online stores with heavy traffic may need VPS or cloud hosting.
- Introductory hosting prices often jump at renewal. Compare the renewal price, not just the first-year offer.
- The domain and hosting accounts must be in your name and email. This is the single most important ownership rule.

Q: How much does a .pk domain cost in 2026?
A: PKNIC charges Pakistani registrants Rs 2,100 per domain per year since 1 August 2026, billed every two years, so Rs 4,200 per billing period. Foreign registrants pay $15.99 a year. Resellers charge more for handling the registration. Check the registrar's total, as some resellers add a service charge.

Q: .pk domain kaise le?
A: PKNIC ki website ya kisi reseller se naam check karein, apne naam aur email par account banayein, kam az kam do saal ki fees (Rs 4,200, yani Rs 2,100 saalana) ada karein, phir domain ko apni hosting se connect karein aur auto-renew on rakhein.

Q: Is .pk or .com better for a Pakistani business?
A: Use a .pk domain if you mainly serve customers in Pakistan, and a .com if you sell internationally. Many businesses register both and point one to the other to protect the brand. Google ranks either normally; content quality, speed and relevance matter far more than the domain extension.

Q: How much is web hosting in Pakistan per year?
A: Shared hosting suitable for most business websites costs about Rs 5,500 to Rs 15,000 a year in Pakistan. Busy online stores and web applications may need VPS or cloud hosting, which typically costs Rs 25,000 or more a year. Always compare renewal prices, not only first-year offers.

Q: Should my developer register the domain for me?
A: They can do the work, but the domain must be registered in your name and email. If it is registered to the developer, you may lose your website and email address if the relationship ends. If they set it up, make sure your name and email are the registrant details.

Q: Is hosting included in a website price?
A: Usually not. Most professional developers recommend you buy hosting in your own name and pay the host directly, so you stay in control. Some offer hosting as part of a maintenance plan; check whose name the account is in. Ask every developer to state this clearly in the quote.

Q: What happens if my domain expires?
A: Your website and business email stop working as soon as the domain expires. After a short grace period, someone else can register it, including competitors. Turn on auto-renew, keep the registrar contact email current, and set a calendar reminder a month before each renewal date.

Q: Do I need to pay for an SSL certificate?
A: Usually not. Most hosting companies in Pakistan and abroad include a free SSL certificate, which gives your website the padlock and the https address that browsers and Google expect. Paid certificates are only needed in special cases, such as organisation-validated certificates for some financial or government-facing sites.

## Landing Page Design Cost in Pakistan, and When One Page Is Enough
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/landing-page-design-cost-in-pakistan
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A landing page price in Pakistan depends on copy, tracking and speed work; ours is Rs 22,500 for one fast page with WhatsApp and call buttons, a form and conversion tracking. One page is enough for a single service or ad campaign; for several services, build a full website.
Key points:
- A landing page has one goal, such as a WhatsApp enquiry, a call or a form submission. Everything on the page should support that goal.
- For paid ads, Google rewards pages that are relevant to the ad, fast and easy to use on mobile.
- Tracking WhatsApp clicks, calls and form submissions is part of the job, not an extra.
- One page is enough for a single service, an event, a product launch or a seasonal offer.
- Our landing page price is Rs 22,500; a full starter website is Rs 40,500.

Q: How much does a landing page cost in Pakistan?
A: Our landing page costs Rs 22,500 and includes a mobile-first single page, WhatsApp and call buttons, a form, conversion tracking and speed optimisation. Other providers' prices vary widely, so compare whether copy, tracking and speed work are included. Tracking and copywriting can be added if your campaign needs them.

Q: Is a landing page enough for my business?
A: A landing page is enough if you sell one main service, run a specific ad campaign or launch one product or event. If you offer many services or want to rank for many searches in Google, a full website is better.

Q: What is the difference between a landing page and a website?
A: A landing page is one page with one goal, usually an enquiry, and little navigation. A website has several pages that describe the whole business and supports many goals, such as information, trust and different services. Many businesses start with a landing page and grow it into a full site later.

Q: Do I need a landing page for Google Ads?
A: It is strongly recommended. Google considers landing page experience in ad quality, so a page that matches the ad and works well on mobile usually performs better than sending visitors to a general home page. A focused page also makes conversion tracking simpler and more accurate.

Q: How fast should a landing page load?
A: Aim for the main content to load within about 2.5 seconds on mobile, which is Google's good threshold for Largest Contentful Paint. Compress images, avoid heavy scripts and test on a phone using mobile data. Test it on a phone using mobile data, not only on office Wi-Fi.

Q: Can I track WhatsApp leads from a landing page?
A: Yes. WhatsApp button clicks, phone-number taps and form submissions can each be tracked as events in Google Analytics, and imported into Google Ads or Meta Ads as conversions. That lets you divide ad spend by enquiries and see the real cost of each lead your campaign produces.

Q: Can a landing page be turned into a full website later?
A: Yes. If the landing page is built on the same platform and design system as your future website, its content, sections and styling carry straight into a starter or business website. Ask for this at the start, so you do not pay twice for the same design work later.

## Website Redesign Cost: When to Redesign, When to Fix, and What It Costs
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-redesign-cost
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: Website redesign cost is usually about the same as a new site of the same size: Rs 40,500 for a small site and Rs 85,500 for ten pages with us. Many sites only need fixes to speed, mobile layout, content or calls to action, which cost less and protect your existing Google rankings.
Key points:
- Redesign when the platform is outdated, the site cannot be edited, or the brand has changed. Fix when the problems are speed, content or conversion.
- A redesign is priced like a new build because the design, development and testing work is similar.
- Keep your URLs where possible, or set up 301 redirects for every changed URL, to protect search rankings.
- Measure before and after: traffic, enquiries, speed and rankings for your main pages.
- Ask for a fix-first audit before paying for a full redesign.

Q: How much does a website redesign cost in Pakistan?
A: A full redesign is usually priced like a new site of the same size. With us that means Rs 40,500 for up to five pages and Rs 85,500 for up to ten pages. Smaller fixes for speed, mobile layout or conversions cost less and are quoted after an audit.

Q: Will redesigning my website affect my Google rankings?
A: It can, if URLs change without redirects or pages that bring traffic are removed or heavily rewritten. Keeping URLs where possible, mapping 301 redirects for every changed address, preserving important content and submitting a new sitemap in Search Console protects most rankings during a redesign.

Q: How do I know if my website needs a redesign?
A: Redesign if you cannot edit the site, it is built on an unsupported platform, it is not mobile-friendly, or your brand has changed. If the problems are speed, content or low enquiries, targeted fixes are usually enough. A short audit can tell you which situation you are in.

Q: What is a 301 redirect?
A: A 301 redirect permanently sends visitors and search engines from an old URL to a new one. It passes most of the old page's search value to the new page, which is why every changed URL needs one during a redesign.

Q: How long does a website redesign take?
A: A small site redesign usually takes two to four weeks, a business site four to eight weeks, and an online store or platform move longer. The timeline depends mostly on how much content must be migrated, how quickly feedback is given and how many redirects need testing.

Q: Can I keep my content and just change the design?
A: Yes. A design refresh keeps your page structure, URLs and content, and changes only how the site looks. It is often the cheapest way to modernise a site that still works well, and it carries much less risk to your Google rankings than a full rebuild.

Q: Should I change platforms during a redesign?
A: Only if the current platform limits you, for example if you cannot edit or export it, or it is no longer supported. Moving adds content and URL migration work, so plan and budget it from the start. Map every old URL to its new address before launch.

## Why Website Quotes Vary From Rs 20,000 to Rs 500,000 (and How to Compare Them)
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/why-website-quotes-vary
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: Website prices vary from about Rs 20,000 to Rs 500,000 in Pakistan because quotes describe different products: a theme versus original design, your text versus written content, a contact form versus payments and integrations, and no support versus a maintained site you own. Compare quotes line by line.
Key points:
- The total price hides the real differences; the scope lines explain them.
- Low quotes often leave out content, testing, licences, backups and ownership of the domain.
- High quotes are worth it only if the extra work matches your goals, such as selling abroad, integrations or custom design.
- Ask every developer the same eight questions and put the answers in one table.
- Never compare a quote that includes content and support with one that does not.

Q: Why are website prices so different in Pakistan?
A: Because developers quote for different products under the same word, website. Design approach, number of pages, who writes the content, features and integrations, testing, licences, ownership of the domain and support after launch all vary, and each changes the amount of skilled work behind the price.

Q: Is a cheap website always bad?
A: No. A cheap template site can be fine for a business that just needs a basic online presence. Problems arise when low prices leave out ownership, licences, mobile testing, backups or basic SEO without saying so. Ask for the list of inclusions and exclusions before deciding.

Q: How do I compare website quotes fairly?
A: Ask every developer the same questions about pages, content, design, features, SEO basics, testing, ownership, payment schedule and support, then put the answers side by side in one table. Compare complete answers rather than totals; the cheapest complete answer is usually the best value.

Q: What should a website quotation include?
A: A professional quotation lists the pages, the design approach and revision rounds, features and integrations, who supplies the content, SEO basics, testing, ownership of the domain and hosting, the payment schedule, the timeline with milestones and the support included after launch.

Q: Should I pay 100% upfront for a website?
A: It is safer not to. Pay a deposit to start, a payment at a mid-project checkpoint and the balance on delivery, with the scope agreed in writing first. Full upfront payment leaves you with very little leverage if the work slows down or the developer stops responding.

Q: Why do some developers charge Rs 500,000 for a website?
A: Large quotes usually cover custom design, extensive copywriting, many integrations, online payments, several languages or a big product catalogue, plus project management and ongoing support. Ask which lines drive the price and whether your business genuinely needs each of them before comparing it with smaller quotes.

## How to Choose a Web Development Company in Pakistan: 20 Questions to Ask First
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/how-to-choose-web-development-company
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: To choose a web development company in Pakistan, compare written answers, not sales calls. Ask each firm the same 20 questions about past work, who builds your site, scope, ownership, payments, testing and support. Choose the one whose answers are specific and written into the agreement, and walk away from anyone who wants full payment upfront.
Key points:
- Ask every company the same questions in writing, so the answers can be compared side by side.
- The most important answers are about ownership: the domain, hosting, code and admin accounts must be in your name.
- A specific written scope matters more than a low price; vague scopes cause most disputes.
- Milestone payments protect both sides. Full payment upfront removes your leverage.
- Speak to at least one past client and open at least three live sites the company has built.

Q: How do I choose a good web development company in Pakistan?
A: Send the same written questions to three or four companies, check at least three live sites each has built, and speak to a past client. Choose the company that gives a specific written scope, milestone payments and ownership of the domain, hosting and code in your name, rather than simply the lowest price.

Q: What questions should I ask a web developer before hiring?
A: Ask about live examples of past work, who will build your site, the written scope, revision rounds, content, platform, timeline, ownership of the domain and code, total price, payment schedule, running costs, testing, SEO basics, security, backups, support after launch and what happens if you part ways.

Q: Is the cheapest web development company a bad choice?
A: Not always, but a very low quote usually leaves something out, such as content, testing, licences, backups or ownership. Ask the cheapest company to list exactly what is included and excluded. If the list matches the others and the answers are specific, the lower price may be genuine value.

Q: Should I pay a web developer 100% upfront?
A: It is safer not to. A fair structure is a deposit to begin, a payment at a mid-project checkpoint and the balance on delivery, all against a written scope. Paying everything upfront leaves you with very little leverage if the project slows down or the developer stops replying.

Q: Web developer hire karne se pehle kya poochna chahiye?
A: Pehle teen live websites dekhein jo unhon ne banai hon, aur ek purane client se baat karein. Phir likhit scope, total qeemat, milestone payments, timeline, aur yeh poochein ke domain, hosting aur code aap ke naam par honge ya nahi. Jo company yeh sab likh kar de, wohi behtar hai.

Q: Can a web development company guarantee first page on Google?
A: No honest company can guarantee a ranking, because Google decides results using many factors that no developer controls. A good company can promise specific work instead: correct titles and descriptions, structured data, a sitemap, fast mobile pages and a Search Console set-up. Treat ranking guarantees as a red flag.

- A local office lets you meet the team, but meeting in person is not a substitute for a written agreement.
- Lahore prices range widely; compare scope line by line before comparing totals.
- Ask who actually builds the site; some firms resell work to freelancers.

Q: Which is the best web development company in Lahore?

The best choice for you shows live sites it built, gives a written scope and fixed price, works on milestone payments and registers your domain, hosting and code in your name. Compare firms using the same checks.

Q: How much does a website cost in Lahore?

## Freelancer vs Agency vs Software House: Who Should Build Your Website?
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/freelancer-vs-agency-vs-software-house
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: Freelancer vs agency for a website comes down to size and risk. A freelancer suits a small site with a tight budget if you can manage the project yourself. An agency suits business sites and online stores that need design, content and support. A software house suits custom web applications with complex logic, integrations and long-term development.
Key points:
- Freelancers are usually cheapest but carry the highest risk if they become unavailable.
- Agencies cost more but bring design, development, content and testing under one contract.
- Software houses are built for custom applications, not usually for small brochure sites.
- Whoever you choose, insist on a written scope, milestone payments and ownership in your name.
- A larger team is not automatically better; check who will actually work on your project.

Q: Is it better to hire a freelancer or an agency for a website?
A: For a small site or landing page with a tight budget, a skilled freelancer can be good value if you manage the project closely. For business websites and online stores, an agency is usually safer because it provides design, development, testing and support from a team, so the project does not depend on one person.

Q: Is a freelancer cheaper than an agency in Pakistan?
A: Usually yes, because a freelancer has lower overheads. The saving can disappear if the freelancer becomes unavailable, leaves work unfinished or skips testing, content and backups. Compare what each quote includes, not only the total, and keep the domain, hosting and logins in your own name either way.

Q: What is the difference between an agency and a software house?
A: A web agency focuses on websites and online stores: design, content, development and marketing basics. A software house focuses on custom software such as web applications, portals and integrations, with engineers, quality testing and project managers. Many firms do both, so ask for examples of projects similar to yours.

Q: Website banwane ke liye freelancer se rabta karein ya company se?
A: Chhoti website ya landing page ke liye achha freelancer kam qeemat mein kaam kar sakta hai, lekin agar woh ghaib ho jaye to masla hota hai. Business website ya online store ke liye company behtar hai kyun ke team hoti hai. Dono soorat mein domain, hosting aur code apne naam par rakhein.

Q: How do I protect myself when hiring a freelancer?
A: Register the domain and hosting in your own name, agree a written scope and milestone payments, and ask for the files and admin access at every milestone. If you hire through a marketplace, use its escrow or payment protection. Never share your main email password; create separate access for the freelancer instead.

Q: Do I need a software house for an online store?
A: Usually not. Most online stores in Pakistan are built well on Shopify or WooCommerce by an agency with e-commerce experience. A software house becomes useful when the store needs custom features, such as complex pricing, a marketplace with many sellers or deep integration with warehouse or accounting software.

## Website Development Contract Checklist: 15 Clauses to Agree Before You Pay
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-development-contract-checklist
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A website development contract should state the scope, price, payment milestones, timeline, revision rounds, ownership of the domain, hosting and code, licences, change requests, delays, testing, handover, support and how either side can end the project. A two-page agreement covering these points prevents most disputes. It does not need to be long.
Key points:
- Agree the contract before paying any deposit.
- The ownership and handover clauses protect you most; never leave them out.
- A change-request clause stops scope creep from turning into arguments about money.
- Define what "done" means for each milestone, so payments are tied to visible work.
- Short and specific beats long and vague. This checklist is not legal advice; ask a lawyer for large projects.

Q: What should a website development contract include?
A: It should include both parties, the scope with exclusions, the platform, who supplies content, total price, payment milestones, timeline, revision rounds, change requests, ownership of the domain and code, licences, testing and acceptance, handover, support after launch and how either side can end the project fairly.

Q: Do I need a contract for a small website?
A: Yes, even a one-page agreement helps. Small projects cause disputes too, usually about pages, content, revisions or ownership of the domain. A short written agreement that both sides sign or confirm by email takes an hour to prepare and saves weeks of argument if expectations differ later.

Q: Who owns the website code after the project?
A: That depends on the contract, which is why the ownership clause matters. A fair agreement says the client owns the code, design and content once the final payment is made, and that the domain and hosting are in the client's name from the start. Without such a clause, ownership can be disputed.

Q: Is a WhatsApp agreement valid for a website project?
A: Written messages can show what was agreed, but a scattered chat is hard to rely on. It is better to put the scope, price, milestones and ownership in one short document, then confirm it by email or WhatsApp. For larger projects, ask a lawyer about signatures and enforceability.

Q: What is a change request in a website project?
A: A change request is any work outside the agreed scope, such as an extra page, a new feature or a different design direction. A good contract says change requests are quoted separately, approved in writing and added to the timeline, so the project stays fair to both the client and the developer.

Q: Website banwane ka agreement kaisa hona chahiye?
A: Agreement mein pages aur features ki list, total qeemat, milestone payments, timeline, revisions ki tadaad, aur yeh likha ho ke domain, hosting aur code aap ke naam par honge. Launch par saare logins aur files milne ki shart bhi likhein. Saada zubaan kaafi hai, lambe legal alfaaz zaroori nahi.

## Who Owns Your Website? Domain, Hosting and Code Ownership Explained
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/who-owns-your-website
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: Who owns your website depends on whose name is on six things: the domain, the hosting account, the code and design, the admin login, the business email and your Google accounts. If any of them sits in your developer's name, they control that part. Check each one today and move it into your own name.
Key points:
- Website ownership is six separate things, not one.
- The domain matters most: whoever controls it controls your website and email.
- Paying for a website does not automatically transfer ownership; the agreement and account names decide it.
- Add your developer as a user on your accounts instead of letting them own the accounts.
- If a developer refuses to hand over access, start with the domain registrar and your written agreement.

Q: How do I know if I own my website?
A: Check six things: the domain registrant, the hosting account, your admin login, your business email, ownership of Google Analytics, Search Console and Business Profile, and a copy of the code. If every one of them is in your name and you can log in yourself, you control your website.

Q: Can a web developer keep my domain name?
A: If the domain was registered in the developer's name, they control it, which is why it should always be registered to you. If it is registered to you but they hold the login, contact the registrar to recover access. Your written agreement and payment records help if there is a dispute.

Q: Who owns the copyright of my website design?
A: Copyright in creative and software work generally starts with whoever creates it, unless an agreement transfers it. A good website contract states that the client owns the design, code and content after final payment. Without that clause, ownership can be unclear, so add it before the project starts.

Q: Should my developer have access to my Google accounts?
A: Yes, but as an added user, not as the owner. Create Analytics, Search Console and Business Profile in your own account, then add the developer with the permissions they need. When the project or contract ends, you simply remove their access, and you keep all the data and history.

Q: Meri website ka maalik kaun hai, kaise check karoon?
A: Dekhein ke domain kis ke naam par register hai, hosting ka bill kis ko aata hai, aur kya aap khud admin panel mein login kar sakte hain. Google Analytics aur Search Console mein bhi owner aap hon. Agar koi cheez developer ke naam par hai, to usay abhi apne naam par muntaqil karwayen.

Q: What should I do if my developer refuses to hand over my website?
A: Ask in writing for each login and the domain transfer code, referring to your agreement and payments. Contact the domain registrar if the domain is in your name. Request a backup, set up hosting in your name and claim your Google accounts through their verification process. Get legal advice for serious disputes.

## Fixed Price vs Hourly Web Development: Which Pricing Model Protects You?
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/fixed-price-vs-hourly-web-development
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: In fixed price vs hourly web development, a fixed price protects you when the scope is clear, such as a business website or standard online store, because the total is known before work starts. Hourly billing suits projects whose requirements will change, such as new web applications, but needs weekly time reports and a budget cap to stay safe.
Key points:
- Fixed price works when you can describe every page and feature in advance.
- Hourly billing works when you are discovering requirements as you go.
- A fixed price is only fixed for the agreed scope; changes are quoted separately.
- With hourly work, always set a budget cap and ask for weekly time reports.
- Many projects combine both: a fixed-price first version, then hourly or monthly improvements.

Q: Is fixed price or hourly better for a website?
A: For most business websites and online stores, fixed price is better because the pages and features can be written down in advance, so you know the total before work starts. Hourly suits projects whose requirements will change, such as new web applications or ongoing improvements, as long as you set a budget cap.

Q: Why do fixed-price website projects sometimes cost more?
A: A fixed price covers only the agreed scope. If you add pages, features or design directions during the project, each change is quoted separately. Costs also rise when content arrives late and work must be redone. A detailed scope and a clear change-request process keep the final total close to the original.

Q: How do I control costs on an hourly web development project?
A: Agree the hourly rate and minimum billing unit in writing, set a weekly or monthly budget cap, ask for time reports that list tasks, and review working software every week or two. If hours rise without visible progress, pause and discuss before approving more time.

Q: What is time and materials pricing?
A: Time and materials is another name for hourly pricing. You pay for the hours actually worked at an agreed rate, plus any costs such as licences or paid services. It offers flexibility when requirements are uncertain, but it moves the risk of overruns from the developer to the client.

Q: Can I combine fixed price and hourly pricing?
A: Yes, and many projects should. A common approach is a fixed-price first version with the core features, followed by hourly or monthly development for improvements based on real user feedback. This keeps the initial budget predictable while allowing the product to grow in the right direction.

Q: Website ke liye fixed qeemat behtar hai ya ghante ke hisaab se?
A: Agar aap ko pata hai ke kitne pages aur kaun se features chahiye, to fixed qeemat behtar hai kyun ke total pehle se maloom hota hai. Naye app ya badalte requirements ke liye ghante ke hisaab se kaam theek hai, lekin mahana had aur haftawar report zaroor rakhein.

## How to Write a Website Brief: Free Template and Worked Example
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-brief-template
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A website brief template covers ten points: your business, goals, customers, pages, features, content, design preferences, examples you like, budget and deadline. Filling it in takes about 30 minutes, and sending the same brief to every developer gives you accurate quotes you can compare fairly. Copy the template below.
Key points:
- A brief is one or two pages, not a technical specification.
- Goals and customers matter more than colours and fonts.
- Listing features precisely is what makes quotes comparable.
- Share your budget range; it helps developers suggest the right scope.
- Send the identical brief to every developer you approach.

Q: What should a website brief include?
A: A website brief should include your business background, the goal of the website, your customers, the pages you expect, the features you need, who supplies the content, design preferences, two or three example websites you like, a budget range and a deadline. One or two pages covering these points is enough for most projects.

Q: How long should a website brief be?
A: For most business websites and online stores, one or two pages is enough. The aim is to describe your goals and needs clearly, not to write a technical specification. Web applications need a little more detail, such as user types, main tasks and integrations, but should still be readable in a few minutes.

Q: Should I tell developers my budget?
A: Yes, share a range. It helps developers propose a scope that fits, rather than guessing high or low. A range also makes it easier to compare quotes, because each developer explains what they can deliver for that amount. You can still negotiate once you see the written scope and price.

Q: What is the difference between a brief and a requirements document?
A: A brief describes your business, goals and needs in plain language so developers can quote. A requirements document, usually written with the developer after you choose one, lists every page, feature and rule in detail and becomes part of the agreement. The brief comes first; the requirements follow.

Q: Website brief Urdu mein likh sakte hain?
A: Ji haan. Brief kisi bhi zubaan mein ho sakta hai, zaroori yeh hai ke saaf ho. Apna kaarobar, website ka maqsad, customers, pages, features, content kaun likhega, pasand ki websites, budget aur deadline likh dein. Yahi brief har developer ko bhejein taake qeematon ka muqabla aasaan ho.

Q: Can a developer help me write the brief?
A: Yes. Many developers will ask questions on a call and turn your answers into a brief or written scope. It still helps to prepare the ten points yourself first, because you know your business and customers best, and the same brief lets you compare several developers fairly.

## Web Developer Portfolio Red Flags: How to Check a Developer's Past Work
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/web-developer-portfolio-red-flags
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: To check a web developer portfolio, open at least three live sites on your phone, test their speed and forms, confirm the developer's credit or ask the client, and look at when each site was built. Red flags include screenshots instead of live links, sites that no longer work, identical templates and no client willing to speak.
Key points:
- Live links beat screenshots; anyone can screenshot a site they did not build.
- Test portfolio sites on your phone, because that is how your customers will see yours.
- Ask what the developer did on each site; "we worked on it" can mean a single fix.
- Free tools can show a site's speed, its platform and how it looked in the past.
- One reference call with a past client is worth more than ten portfolio images.

Q: How do I check if a web developer actually built a website?
A: Ask what they did on that site and who on their team worked on it, look for a developer credit in the footer, check the Wayback Machine to see when the design appeared, and ask to speak to the client. A developer who built the site will answer in detail and usually connect you with the client.

Q: What are red flags in a web developer portfolio?
A: Warning signs include screenshots instead of live links, broken or expired sites, every design looking the same, slow or broken mobile pages, no recent work, famous brand names without detail, forms that do not work and no past client willing to speak. Two or more of these deserve serious caution.

Q: How many portfolio sites should I check?
A: Check at least three live sites, ideally similar to your project, such as an online store if you need one. Test each on your phone using mobile data, run Google PageSpeed Insights on the homepage and try a contact form or WhatsApp button. This takes about fifteen minutes per developer.

Q: Is it a red flag if a developer has no portfolio?
A: Not necessarily, if they are new. Ask for their best one or two projects, consider a short paid test task, or start with a smaller first milestone so you can judge their work before committing the full budget. Be more careful if an experienced firm claims many years but cannot show live work.

Q: Developer ka portfolio kaise check karein?
A: Kam az kam teen live websites apne mobile par kholein aur dekhein ke jaldi load hoti hain ya nahi. Contact form ya WhatsApp button try karein. Developer se poochein ke us site par unhon ne khud kya kaam kiya, aur kisi purane client se baat karwane ka kahein. Sirf screenshots par bharosa na karein.

Q: Can a developer use templates in their portfolio?
A: Using a good theme or template is normal and can keep costs down. The concern is when a developer presents a template demo as original work, or every site is the same template with little change. Ask which sites used a theme, what they customised, and whether licences were bought in the client's name.

## Website Advance Payment and Milestones: How a Fair Payment Plan Works
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-milestone-payments
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A fair website advance payment is usually 30 to 50 percent, followed by a mid-project payment after you approve the design or see a working staging site, and the balance on launch. Each payment should follow work you can see. Paying 100 percent upfront removes your leverage; paying nothing until the end is unfair to the developer.
Key points:
- Milestones protect both sides: the developer is paid for progress, and you pay only for work you can see.
- A 30 to 50 percent advance is common; larger advances need a good reason.
- Define each milestone as a visible result, such as an approved design or a working staging site.
- Hold the final payment until the site is live and handed over.
- Keep receipts and confirmations of every payment and approval.

Q: How much advance payment should I give for a website?
A: A 30 to 50 percent advance is common for website projects in Pakistan, paid after you approve a written scope, price and timeline. The rest is usually split between a mid-project payment after design approval or a working staging site, and a final payment after launch and handover of all logins and files.

Q: Is it safe to pay a web developer 100% upfront?
A: It is risky. Full payment upfront leaves you with no leverage if the project slows down or the developer stops replying, and recovering money is difficult. A milestone plan, where each payment follows visible work, protects you while still paying the developer fairly for progress made at each stage.

Q: What is a milestone payment in a website project?
A: A milestone payment is a part of the total price paid when a defined stage is completed and approved, such as an approved design, a working staging site or the live launch. Milestones tie money to visible progress, so both the client and the developer know exactly when each payment is due.

Q: When should I make the final website payment?
A: Make the final payment once the site is live, tested and handed over: you should have the domain, hosting and admin logins in your name, a full backup and any documentation. Agree this in writing at the start, so the final payment is linked to handover and not just to the site going live.

Q: Website ke liye kitna advance dena chahiye?
A: Aam tor par 30 se 50 feesad advance diya jata hai, likhit scope aur qeemat tay hone ke baad. Baqi raqam design manzoor hone ya test website dekhne ke baad, aur aakhri qist launch aur saare logins milne par di jati hai. Poori raqam pehle dena mehfooz nahi.

Q: What happens to my advance if the project is cancelled?
A: That depends on your agreement, which is why it should include an ending clause. A fair approach is that the developer keeps payment for work already completed and hands over that work, while any unused portion is refunded or credited. Agree these terms in writing before paying the advance.

## Website Handover Checklist: Everything You Must Receive at Launch
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/website-handover-checklist
Updated: 2026-10-28
Short answer: A website handover checklist covers five groups: account access (domain, hosting, admin, email, Google tools), files and backups, licences for themes and plugins, documentation for editing the site, and a short support agreement. Receive and test every item before the final payment, so you can run or move your website without depending on one developer.
Key points:
- Handover is complete only when you can log in to every account yourself.
- Test each login before the final payment, not after.
- Ask for a full backup stored outside the hosting account.
- Licences must be in your name, or you may lose updates and support.
- Change shared passwords after handover and remove access you no longer need.

Q: What should I receive when my website is finished?
A: You should receive login access to the domain, hosting, website admin, email and Google tools in your own name, a full backup, the source or design files, licences for themes and plugins, a short editing guide, a list of renewal dates and costs, and the support terms in writing.

Q: Should I pay the developer before or after handover?
A: Make the final payment after handover is complete and tested. Agree at the start that the last milestone covers launch plus delivery of all logins, files, licences and documentation. This protects you, and a professional developer will be comfortable with it because it is a normal, fair structure.

Q: What is a website handover document?
A: A handover document lists every account, who owns it and how to access it, plus the plugins or apps used, renewal dates and costs, and how forms, redirects and email notifications work. It lets you or any future developer run, edit and move the website without depending on the original developer.

Q: How do I keep my website secure after handover?
A: Change any passwords shared during the project, turn on two-step verification on the domain, hosting, email and admin accounts, remove developer accounts you no longer need and keep an offline backup. Store a list of accounts somewhere safe that a trusted colleague can reach in an emergency.

Q: Website mukammal hone par developer se kya kya lena chahiye?
A: Domain, hosting, website admin aur email ke logins apne naam par lein, poora backup, design files, themes aur plugins ke licence, website edit karne ki choti guide aur renewal ki tareekhein. Sab kuch khud login kar ke check karein, phir aakhri payment karein.

Q: Do I need the source code if my site is on Shopify?
A: Shopify hosts the platform, so you do not receive server code, but you should own the store account and have the theme files, any custom code and a product export. For WordPress or custom builds, a full backup or repository transfer is essential because it lets another developer take over.

## WordPress vs Shopify vs Custom Website: Which Platform Fits a Pakistani Business?
URL: https://kambohassociates.com/digital/blog/wordpress-vs-shopify-vs-custom-website
Updated: 2026-10-29
Short answer: In the WordPress vs Shopify choice, pick WordPress for an information or service website, Shopify for a product store that wants low upkeep, and a custom build only for bookings, portals or workflows no platform handles. Shopify starts at $29 a month billed yearly; WordPress needs only hosting from about Rs 5,500 a year.
Key points:
- WordPress suits service, clinic, consultant and company websites that are mostly pages, articles and enquiry forms.
- Shopify suits product stores that want hosting, security and checkout handled for them, at a monthly dollar fee.
- A custom build is worth it only when your business process, such as bookings or a client portal, does not fit a platform.
- Shopify Payments is not available in Pakistan, so Shopify stores here use COD and third-party gateways, which carry a Shopify fee.
- Choose the platform by business type first, then by budget, editing needs and who will maintain it.

Q: Is WordPress or Shopify better for a small business in Pakistan?
A: WordPress is better for service businesses such as clinics, consultants and factories, because hosting is cheap and editing pages is easy.
